title: Sales Manager- Area sales
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
   

  

 This Position reports to:
   

  

 Sales Director\- Maharashtra \& Southeast Asia
   

  

  

  

  

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will be responsible for growing sales of B\&R’s next generation technology, machine connectivity, automation \& edge, high end motion system \& technology software solutions in the defined area. The role demands a mix of sales acumen, technical understanding, and customer engagement.
   

  

 The work model for the role is: Hybrid
   

  

 This role is contributing to the Machine Automation Division \-B\&R in Pune region in India. Main stakeholders include Customers, Sales Team, Engineering Team, Project Management Team, and Senior Leadership.
   

  

**You will be mainly accountable for:**
* Build and maintain good customer relationships while generating new business opportunities and managing a healthy sales pipeline.
* Understand customer needs and develop value\-based techno\-commercial automation solutions.
* Support business growth through negotiations, opportunity conversion, and meeting sales targets.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to ensure on\-time project delivery and high customer satisfaction.
* Represent the organization as a trusted automation advisor, promoting solutions, market growth, and long\-term customer partnerships.


**Qualifications For The Role**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or a related field).
* 8–10 years of demonstrated sales experience within industrial automation environments, with experience in PLCs, SCADA, Drives, Motion Control, and Mechatronics solutions.
* Solid experience in industrial sales, consultative selling, and delivering automation solutions aligned to customer needs.
* Solid experience in automation applications and translating technical requirements into practical business solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to negotiate, manage customer relationships, and convert business opportunities into deals.
* Solid communication, professionalism, and stakeholder management skills; fluency in English, with additional regional language skills considered an advantage.


**More about us:**
 B\&R Industrial Automation is a manufacturer of automation technology and ABB's global center for machine and factory automation. B\&R was founded in 1979 by Erwin Bernecker and Josef Rainer and has its headquarters in Eggelsberg, Upper Austria. Today, B\&R is a leading global solution provider for automating machines and factories and is responsible for machine automation in ABB's Robotics \& Discrete Automation division.
   

  

 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
   

  

 Recruitment Fraud Warning
   

  

 ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.
   

  

 View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home
   

  

 For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how\-to\-apply/fraud\-warning

title: Technical Sales Specialist
description:
Technical Sales Engineer – Flexible Chain Conveyors
 
**Company:** 
 Iconmov Technologies Private Limited
 



**Location:** 
 Pune / Maharashtra
 



**Department:** 
 Technical Sales \& Business Development
 



**Experience:** 
 2–6 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 


 About the Role
 
 Iconmov Technologies is looking for a
 **Technical Sales Engineer – Flexible Chain Conveyors** 
 to take ownership of developing and expanding our
 **Flexible Chain Conveyor business** 
 across India.
 



 This is a highly
 **field\-oriented technical sales role** 
 for someone who enjoys understanding customer applications, visiting manufacturing plants, identifying automation and material\-handling requirements, developing the right conveyor solution, and converting those opportunities into business.
 



 The person will be expected to
 **step out extensively, meet customers, understand their production processes, work with engineering teams to develop solutions, and build a strong customer base** 
 in high\-potential industries such as
 **Food, Pharma, Packaging and FMCG** 
 .
 



 This is an opportunity to build a category rather than simply sell an existing product portfolio.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Develop the
 **Flexible Chain Conveyor business** 
 for Iconmov Technologies across the assigned territory.
* Identify and develop new customers in
 **Food, Pharma, Packaging, FMCG and allied manufacturing industries** 
 .
* Conduct regular customer visits to understand production lines, material\-flow requirements and conveyor applications.
* Understand customer processes and translate application requirements into appropriate conveyor solutions.
* Identify opportunities for
 **new conveyor installations, line modifications, replacements and upgrades** 
 .
* Generate leads through direct customer visits, industry networking, references, exhibitions and systematic market development.
* Work closely with customers, machine builders, system integrators, OEMs and plant engineering teams.
* Prepare technical proposals, conveyor concepts, quotations and commercial offers in coordination with the internal engineering team.
* Participate in technical discussions and present solutions to customers.
* Follow up on enquiries from initial application understanding through negotiation and order closure.
* Develop long\-term relationships with key accounts and create repeat business.
* Map target industries, customers and applications to build a strong sales pipeline.
* Study competitor products and market trends and identify opportunities for Iconmov's Flexible Chain Conveyor solutions.
* Coordinate with design, engineering, production and execution teams to ensure smooth project delivery.
* Take ownership of sales targets, pipeline development and business growth for the assigned product category.
* Build Iconmov's presence and reputation as a
 **technical solution provider for conveyor applications** 
 .


 What We Are Looking For
 * Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech. in
 **Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Production Engineering or related field** 
 .
* 2–6 years of experience in
 **technical sales, application engineering, conveyor systems, industrial automation, material handling or machine\-building** 
 .
* Strong understanding of industrial manufacturing processes and mechanical systems.
* Candidates with experience in
 **conveyors, conveyor components, packaging machinery, food\-processing machinery, pharma machinery or factory automation** 
 will be preferred.
* Ability to understand drawings, layouts and basic mechanical concepts.
* Good application\-oriented problem\-solving ability.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Comfortable interacting with
 **plant heads, production managers, maintenance teams, purchase teams, machine builders and engineering teams** 
 .
* Willingness to travel extensively and spend significant time
 **meeting customers and developing business in the field** 
 .
* Strong commercial sense and the ability to convert technical discussions into business opportunities.
* Self\-driven, proactive and capable of working independently.


 The Ideal Candidate
 
 We are looking for someone who is
 **not just an order\-taking salesperson** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should be someone who can walk into a manufacturing plant, understand the customer's production process, identify where a conveyor solution can improve the operation, discuss the application technically, develop the right solution with the engineering team and ultimately convert the opportunity into an order.
 



 Someone with a
 **hunter mindset, strong technical curiosity and a passion for industrial sales** 
 would be an excellent fit.
 


 Why Join Iconmov?
 * Opportunity to
 **build and lead a high\-potential product category** 
 .
* Exposure to some of India's leading
 **Food, Pharma, Packaging and FMCG manufacturers** 
 .
* Opportunity to work on diverse industrial automation and material\-handling applications.
* Significant scope for
 **business ownership and career growth** 
 .
* Work closely with customers and engineering teams to develop application\-specific solutions.
* Performance\-driven role with the opportunity to grow along with the business.


 Key Performance Indicators
 * New customer acquisition
* Qualified opportunity / pipeline development
* Customer visits and application identification
* Enquiry generation and conversion
* New project development
* Revenue growth from Flexible Chain Conveyors
* Development of strategic accounts
* Repeat business and customer relationships



**If you enjoy technical selling, customer interaction and building industrial businesses from the ground up, we would like to hear from you.**

description:
**Company Description** 
 Let's Manage India Pvt Ltd is a B2B multi\-service firm focused on providing end\-to\-end business management solutions under one roof. The company supports clients with services ranging from business registration and professional accounting by experienced CAs to website and app development by a dedicated tech team. A highly qualified marketing team offers customized door\-to\-door and digital marketing plans aligned with client budgets to boost sales and visibility. By simplifying complex processes into a single, streamlined solution, Let's Manage enables businesses to focus on growth while the firm manages their operational and promotional needs.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Client Acquisition Executive is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Pune Division, responsible for identifying and securing new business clients for Let's Manage India Pvt Ltd. The role involves prospecting and qualifying leads, conducting client meetings and presentations, and explaining the firm’s integrated service offerings and customized solutions. The executive will manage the end\-to\-end acquisition cycle, including follow\-ups, proposal sharing, negotiation within defined parameters, and closing deals. Daily tasks include maintaining an active sales pipeline, updating CRM records, coordinating with internal teams to align service offerings to client needs, and providing regular reporting on lead status and conversion metrics. The role also requires staying informed about market trends, competitor activities, and client feedback to support continuous improvement in acquisition strategies.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Lead Generation and Customer Acquisition skills to build and convert a robust pipeline of potential clients.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to conduct meetings, deliver presentations, and maintain professional client relationships.
* Candidates should possess solid Sales skills to negotiate, close deals, and meet or exceed assigned targets.
* Candidates should possess good Analytical Skills to assess client requirements, segment markets, and interpret sales and performance data.
* Experience in B2B sales or client\-facing roles, preferably in services or consulting, is beneficial.
* Ability to work on\-site in the Pune Division, manage time effectively, and handle multiple prospects simultaneously.
* Basic proficiency in using CRM tools, spreadsheets, and presentation software is advantageous.
* A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is preferred.

title: Inside Sales Executive – Agritech
description:
Inside Sales Executive – Agritech
 



**Company:** 
 KrishiDukan
 



**Location:** 
 Maharashtra
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 years preferred; strong freshers with demonstrated sales ability may apply
 



**Compensation:** 
 Competitive fixed salary based on experience, current compensation and demonstrated sales performance, plus performance\-linked incentives.
 



**Incentives:** 
 Additional performance\-linked incentives
 



**Languages:** 
 Marathi and Hindi required; working English preferred
 



 About KrishiDukan
 



 KrishiDukan is an agritech platform connecting farmers, agricultural retailers and agricultural\-product manufacturers.
 



 The platform helps farmers discover agricultural products and nearby retailers, enables retailers to build a digital presence and receive enquiries or online orders, and allows manufacturers to display their products across retailer locations.
 



 KrishiDukan operates through its website and mobile application and is building a technology\-enabled distribution and product\-discovery ecosystem for the agricultural sector.
 



 Website: https://krishidukan.com
 



 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a result\-oriented Inside Sales Executive who can independently identify prospects, conduct cold outreach, demonstrate the KrishiDukan platform, handle objections, close paid subscriptions and follow up until payment is collected.
 



 The role will primarily involve selling KrishiDukan subscriptions and platform services to agricultural\-product manufacturers and retailers.
 



 This is an active sales and business\-development role. The selected candidate will be responsible for the complete sales cycle—from creating the lead database to collecting payment and assisting with initial onboarding.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Research and identify agricultural\-product manufacturers, distributors and retailers across Maharashtra and India.
* Identify founders, directors, sales heads, marketing heads and other relevant decision\-makers.
* Generate leads independently through online research, industry directories, LinkedIn, Google, referrals and existing market networks.
* Make outbound calls, send emails and use WhatsApp professionally to initiate conversations.
* Understand each prospect’s products, distribution network, retailer presence and business requirements.
* Conduct online demonstrations of the KrishiDukan website and mobile application.
* Explain KrishiDukan’s subscription model, product listings, retailer mapping, manufacturer pages, online\-ordering features and promotional opportunities.
* Prepare and share proposals based on the number of products, retailers and subscription duration.
* Handle objections related to pricing, existing distributor networks, expected farmer reach, online orders and return on investment.
* Maintain systematic follow\-ups until the prospect makes a clear decision.
* Close paid subscriptions and take responsibility for payment collection.
* Coordinate with the onboarding and product team after payment.
* Maintain accurate lead, call, demonstration, proposal, follow\-up and collection records.
* Reactivate old leads, incomplete registrations and previously interested prospects.
* Build long\-term relationships to support renewals, upgrades and additional product or retailer listings.
* Share daily updates and weekly sales forecasts with management.
* Provide market feedback, competitor information and recurring customer objections.



 Performance Expectations
 



 After the initial training and ramp\-up period, the role will carry an expected target of approximately
 **₹2,00,000 in collected sales per month** 
 .
 



 Performance will be measured through:
 


* New leads generated
* Decision\-makers contacted
* Outbound calls completed
* Qualified conversations
* Product demonstrations conducted
* Proposals shared
* Follow\-ups completed
* Paid conversions
* Revenue collected
* CRM and reporting accuracy



 Expected daily activity may include:
 


* 40–50 focused outbound calls
* At least 5 qualified conversations
* 2–3 product demonstrations
* Regular follow\-ups on active proposals
* Complete daily CRM updates



 Final performance will be evaluated primarily on actual collections and quality of the active sales pipeline, not only on call volume.
 



 Required Skills
 


* Strong verbal communication in Marathi and Hindi.
* Confidence in cold calling and speaking with business owners.
* Ability to understand and explain a technology platform.
* Strong follow\-up and negotiation skills.
* Ability to communicate professionally over phone, WhatsApp, email and online meetings.
* Comfortable working with sales targets and daily reporting.
* Basic knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets or CRM systems.
* Self\-discipline and ability to work without continuous supervision.
* Ownership of the complete sales process, including payment follow\-up.
* Ability to learn about agricultural products, retailer networks and manufacturer distribution models.



 Preferred Background
 



 Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:
 


* Agricultural inputs
* Seeds, fertilizers, pesticides or bio\-stimulants
* Agritech platforms
* B2B subscription sales
* SaaS or technology\-platform sales
* FMCG distribution
* Telecom sales
* Microfinance
* Dealer or distributor onboarding
* E\-commerce marketplace sales
* Business development and inside sales



 Agricultural experience is preferred but not mandatory if the candidate has strong cold\-calling, demonstration and closing capabilities.
 



 Who Should Apply
 



 Apply if you:
 


* Enjoy speaking with new prospects.
* Can generate your own leads instead of depending entirely on company\-provided data.
* Are comfortable facing rejection and following up consistently.
* Can conduct product demonstrations confidently.
* Take responsibility until the customer pays.
* Want to work in an early\-stage agritech business where individual performance has a visible impact.
* Are comfortable with targets, accountability and transparent daily reporting.



 Who Should Not Apply
 



 This role may not be suitable if you:
 


* Are looking only for customer support or back\-office work.
* Are uncomfortable with cold calling.
* Do not want individual sales targets.
* Consider your responsibility complete after generating a lead.
* Are not comfortable following up for payment.
* Require continuous supervision to complete daily tasks.



 Application Screening Information
 



 Applicants should be prepared to provide:
 


* Current location
* Current and expected salary
* Notice period
* Previous monthly sales target
* Average and highest monthly sales achieved
* Number of daily calls and demonstrations handled
* Experience with payment collection
* Marathi and Hindi proficiency
* Earliest possible joining date



 Shortlisted candidates will be asked to research KrishiDukan and complete a live sales\-pitch exercise during the interview.

title: Business Development Executive - Human Capability Technologies
description:
About LeaderNovo
 
 LeaderNovo works with organisations on talent diagnostics, leadership development and technology\-enabled people solutions. The Human Capability Technologies (HCT) Business Unit focuses on B2B solutions for HR, talent and business teams, including psychometric assessments, AI powered platforms \- SalesPulse and CoachPulse.
 


 Role Purpose
 
 We are looking for an early\-career sales professional to build the market for LeaderNovo's Products portfolio. This is a B2B SaaS sales role involving outbound prospecting, discovery, product demonstrations, pilot conversion and account expansion with corporate clients.
 



 The role requires someone who can understand a client's business problem, position the right product use case, manage a disciplined sales pipeline and move opportunities from first conversation to commercial closure.
 


 Key Responsibilities1\. Prospecting and Account Development
 
 ·  Identify target organisations and relevant decision\-makers across HR, Talent Management, L\&D, Talent Acquisition, Sales and business leadership.
 



 ·  Build and maintain a structured target\-account database and prospecting plan.
 



 ·  Generate new conversations through phone, email, LinkedIn, referrals and other outbound channels.
 



 ·  Research accounts before outreach to identify relevant talent, leadership or sales challenges.
 


 2\. Lead Qualification and Discovery
 
 ·  Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand business needs, current processes, stakeholders, timelines and buying intent.
 



 ·  Qualify opportunities based on problem relevance, fit, decision process, urgency and commercial potential.
 



 ·  Distinguish genuine buying opportunities from general enquiries and exploratory interest.
 


 3\. Consultative Product Selling
 
 ·  Develop a strong working understanding of LeaderNovo's assessments, SalesPulse and CoachPulse and explain their business relevance clearly.
 



 ·  Position products around specific client problems rather than presenting the full product catalogue.
 



 ·  Build use\-case\-led conversations around talent decisions, leadership readiness, sales capability, manager development and behavioural practice.
 



 ·  Involve founders, product, research or pre\-sales colleagues appropriately for deeper solution discussions.
 


 4\. Demonstrations, Pilots and Proposals
 
 ·  Coordinate product demos, sample report walkthroughs and pilot discussions.
 



 ·  Support preparation of proposals, commercial discussions and client follow\-up.
 



 ·  Move qualified prospects toward a defined paid pilot, deployment or product purchase.
 



 ·  Coordinate internally to ensure client requirements and next steps are clearly documented.
 


 5\. Pipeline and Sales Discipline
 
 ·  Maintain accurate opportunity information in the CRM, including stage, value, stakeholders, next action and expected closure.
 



 ·  Track opportunities from prospecting to meeting, qualified opportunity, demo, proposal or pilot, closure and deployment.
 



 ·  Maintain consistent follow\-up and build sufficient qualified pipeline against monthly and quarterly targets.
 



 ·  Provide regular reporting on pipeline health, conversions, risks and likely closures.
 


 6\. Account Expansion and Cross\-Selling
 
 ·  Maintain contact with customers after an initial pilot or deployment and identify opportunities to expand usage across cohorts, teams or business units.
 



 ·  Identify relevant opportunities for other Digital Products.
 



 ·  Refer Learning Services opportunities to the appropriate LeaderNovo team when they emerge, while retaining primary focus on the Digital Products BU.
 


 Key Performance Indicators
 
 ·  Qualified meetings generated
 



 ·  Qualified opportunities created
 



 ·  Paid pilots and product deployments
 



 ·  Revenue and bookings generated
 



 ·  Pilot\-to\-deployment conversion
 



 ·  Opportunity\-to\-sale conversion
 



 ·  Average account value
 



 ·  Qualified pipeline value and coverage
 



 ·  New corporate logos acquired
 



 ·  Account expansion opportunities
 



 ·  CRM and follow\-up discipline
 


 Candidate ProfileEssential
 
 ·  1\-3 years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, business development or inside sales.
 



 ·  Hands\-on experience selling software, technology platforms or subscription\-based B2B products to corporate customers.
 



 ·  Comfort with outbound prospecting and initiating conversations with new accounts.
 



 ·  Ability to conduct structured discovery and understand a client's business requirement before pitching.
 



 ·  Comfort speaking with HR, business and other corporate decision\-makers.
 



 ·  Strong verbal and written communication skills.
 



 ·  Good follow\-up, pipeline management and CRM discipline.
 



 ·  Ability to learn moderately complex products and explain them in simple business language.
 



 ·  Comfort working with sales targets and measurable commercial outcomes.
 


 Preferred
 
 ·  Experience selling HR Tech, assessments, talent solutions, learning technology or AI\-enabled business products.
 



 ·  Exposure to enterprise or mid\-market sales involving multiple stakeholders, demonstrations or pilots.
 



 ·  Familiarity with LinkedIn\-based prospecting, CRM tools and online product demonstrations.
 


 Attributes We Value
 
 ·  Curiosity and the ability to understand the client's problem before pitching
 



 ·  Persistence without overly aggressive selling
 



 ·  Commercial orientation and comfort asking for the next step
 



 ·  Structured follow\-up and personal discipline
 



 ·  Ability to work independently while knowing when to involve senior colleagues
 



 ·  Interest in HR, talent, leadership and workplace technology
 


 Why Join LeaderNovo
 
 You will work closely with LeaderNovo's founders, product and research teams while helping build the commercial engine for a growing portfolio of assessment and AI\-enabled products. The role offers hands\-on exposure to consultative B2B SaaS selling, enterprise conversations, product demonstrations, paid pilots, account\-based selling and the early\-stage scaling of a digital products business.

 **international leads provided by the company**

* Connect with prospective clients through email, WhatsApp, phone calls, LinkedIn, and other relevant communication channels.

* Qualify leads based on
 **business potential, intent, requirement, budget, and purchase timeline** 
 .

* Track pending responses, quotations, samples, negotiations, and purchase decisions.

* Build a strong pipeline of qualified international prospects.

* Coordinate regarding product availability, samples, invoices, shipping requirements, and export documentation.

* Meetings conducted
* Quotations shared

title: Founder's Office
description:
Most roles come with a defined lane. This one offers a view of the entire company.
 



 We are building something ambitious, and we are looking for someone to build it alongside us: a person who sees what needs to be done and takes it forward with ownership and care.
 



 You will work closely with the founders and gain firsthand exposure to how a company is built, from key decisions and trade\-offs to execution and growth. You will not only observe this process; you will play an active role in shaping it.
 



**What you will do** 




 →
 **Drive alignment across teams.** 
 Engineering, design, and business move quickly, and you will help ensure they move in the same direction. This means tracking progress, resolving blockers, and connecting efforts across functions.
 



 →
 **Help build the team.** 
 You will support hiring and coordination, helping bring in the people who will shape the future of the company.
 



 →
 **Support investor relations and fundraising.** 
 From preparing materials and investor updates to participating in conversations, you will gain close exposure to how capital is raised.
 



 →
 **Contribute to business development.** 
 You will help identify, pursue, and manage strategic partnerships that can meaningfully influence our growth.
 



 →
 **Own critical initiatives.** 
 Some of the most important work in a startup does not belong to a single function. That work will be yours to lead.
 



 Some weeks you may be closely following engineering progress; others, you may be in discussions with investors or partners. The variety is part of what makes this role unique.
 



**Who we are looking for** 




 Someone who thinks clearly and executes with speed and precision. You are comfortable working without a fixed playbook and bring structure where there is none. You communicate well with people across functions, whether engineers, designers, or investors, and you take ownership naturally, without needing to be asked.
 



**Experience:** 
 0–3 years. Exceptional freshers are warmly encouraged to apply. We value how you think and what you have done, whether in college, personal projects, or professional work, more than the length of your résumé.
 



**What to expect** 




 This is a demanding role with high expectations and real responsibility. It is fast\-paced and not tightly structured.
 



 In return, it offers something rare: direct exposure to how decisions are made and executed at the highest level of a growing company, and the opportunity to learn and grow faster than almost any other role would allow.
 



**This is one of the most important roles we are hiring for. If it resonates with you, we would be glad to hear from you.**

* Partner with the Sales organization on account targeting, competitive positioning strategy, and technical qualification from initial lead state through formal closure.
* Serve as the primary domain expert during high\-value sales cycles, effectively neutralizing competitor technical objections and proving Jade Global’s superior technical execution capabilities.



  





**Architecture, Estimation \& Deal Scoping** 



* Own the end\-to\-end technical solutioning process for complex, multi\-module ServiceNow pursuits, including architectural blueprints and integration ecosystems.
* Drive rigorous effort estimation reviews, meticulously validating delivery timelines, staffing matrices, and resource mixes to ensure commercial viability and zero delivery slippage.
* Draft and negotiate comprehensive Statements of Work (SOWs), Request for Proposal (RFP) responses, technical roadmaps, and detailed business value realization models.
* Govern the transition from sales to implementation, conducting thorough technical handoffs to Delivery and Practice teams to ensure customer expectations are perfectly executed.



  





**ServiceNow Alliance \& Ecosystem Engagement** 



* Cultivate deep technical and co\-sell alignment with ServiceNow field sales, solution architects, and partner enablement managers to accelerate pipeline growth.
* Represent Jade Global’s technical prowess at premier ServiceNow ecosystem events, including Knowledge, partner forums, and executive roundtables.
* Unlock referral and co\-sell opportunities by demonstrating deep domain expertise to ServiceNow account teams, positioning Jade as the go\-to delivery partner for complex workflows.

* 12–15\+ years of progressive experience in IT consulting, enterprise solution architecture, or technical presales, with a minimum of 6–8 years dedicated exclusively to the ServiceNow platform.
* Deep architectural mastery across the full scope of ServiceNow workflows, specifically ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, IRM/SecOps, WSD and other modules of ServiceNow with platform features like Now Assist / Movework / Creator Workflows.
* Commanding executive presence with a proven track record of influencing enterprise technology stakeholders and C\-level decision\-makers.

* Direct co\-selling experience alongside ServiceNow internal sales and specialist teams.
* Quota\-carrying success, with a demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding personal sales support, pipeline contribution, or booking targets.

* Active ServiceNow Certifications: Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in core modules, Certified Application Developer (CAD), or Certified Technical Architect (CTA) / Certified Master Architect (CMA).
* Vertical Expertise: Proven experience solutioning for complex regulatory or operational environments like Healthcare \& Life Sciences, Manufacturing, High Tech, or Financial Services.
* Automation Fluency: Strong comprehension of AI\-driven workflows, generative AI integrations within ServiceNow (Now Assist), and modern enterprise integration architectures (Integration Hub).



  





**Success Metrics** 



* Achieve assigned ESM pipeline contribution and closed\-won bookings quota.
* Maximize technical win\-rates on critical, highly competitive RFPs and enterprise proposals.
* Expand the Jade Global co\-sell pipeline via proactive collaboration with ServiceNow technical and account field teams.

 A healthy pipeline of qualified leads, consistent client conversions, accurate requirement handovers, timely payment follow\-ups, and strong long\-term client relationships.

 As an Inside Sales Engineer, you will manage the commercial journey from incoming enquiry to quotation, customer follow\-up, and payment coordination. Ltd. offers the opportunity to build deeper expertise in technical inside sales while making a measurable contribution to customer experience, sales conversion, and operational visibility.

 QWR Interactive Solutions designs and manufactures head\-worn computing devices. We have shipped over 50,000 devices across 17 countries and we are India's only domestic full\-stack XR manufacturer. We sell to global consumer electronics brands who need a manufacturing partner, and to defence, enterprise and education customers who need XR solutions.
 



 About the role
 



 We are looking for a business development executive with 1 to 3 years of experience in B2B sales, lead generation or inside sales, ideally in technology, electronics, hardware or enterprise solutions.
 



 This is the role that fills the top of our pipeline. You will find the accounts, open the conversations, qualify what is real, and hand over opportunities that are worth a senior person's time.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Research and build target account lists across electronics, XR, AV, system integrators, education, government and enterprise segments.
 



 Identify decision makers and run first\-level outreach across email, LinkedIn and phone.
 



 Qualify early\-stage leads by understanding use case, requirement fit, budget, timeline and who actually decides.
 



 Maintain accurate records in the CRM, including outreach logs, account notes, next steps and pipeline stage.
 



 Prepare first\-cut proposals, pitch decks and use\-case collateral with support from the wider team.
 



 Coordinate demos, product samples and proof\-of\-concept discussions between the customer and our internal teams.
 



 Follow up consistently. Most B2B deals are lost to silence rather than to a competitor.
 



 Support the team at trade shows, exhibitions and customer visits.
 



 Feed market observations back in, including what buyers are asking for and where we keep losing.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing or a related field.
 



 1 to 3 years in business development, inside sales, lead generation or account support in a B2B context.
 



 Strong written and spoken English. A large part of this role is written outreach to senior people.
 



 Comfortable with cold outreach and with being ignored nine times out of ten without losing momentum.
 



 Working knowledge of a CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or equivalent prospecting tools, and spreadsheets.
 



 Enough technical curiosity to understand a hardware specification and explain it back to a customer in plain language.
 



 Organised and consistent. This role rewards follow\-through more than brilliance.
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 Experience selling electronics, hardware, AV, IT products or enterprise technology.
 



 Exposure to ODM or OEM business models.
 



 Experience with government or institutional tenders.
 



 XR or AR familiarity.
 



 Why QWR
 



 Sell a product built in\-house, not resold. You can take a customer to the factory floor.
 



 Real category position. \#1 in India by units shipped, and expanding into defence and industrial markets.
 



 Direct line to decision makers. This is a small team where your pipeline is visible to leadership every week.
 



  





**Hiring Process** 




 CV screening, a call with the hiring manager, then a practical exercise on a real prospecting brief and a discussion of your approach. We share feedback within 48 hours of every stage.
 



 How to Apply
 



 Apply here on LinkedIn, or send your CV to hr@questionwhatsreal.com quoting the role title in the subject line. If you have built a pipeline from scratch before, tell us how.
 


* QWR Interactive Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. All applications are considered on merit, without regard to gender, religion, caste, age, disability or background.

 We are growing our presence among India's D2C brands. We are hiring a Business Development Representative to build that pipeline from the ground up.

You will qualify genuine opportunities and hand them over to our Business Development Manager as booked demos. This is a target\-driven role with clear, measurable outcomes and structured training from day one.

description:
**About the Company:** 




 KOEL Fluid Dynamics Business Unit (earlier known as La\-Gajjar Machineries Private Limited) , is a premier provider of water pumping solutions and now a 100% wholly owned subsidiary of Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited (KOEL). Founded in 1935 in Ahmedabad by the visionary Mr. Laljibhai J. Gajjar, the company has evolved into an international leader through its renowned brand, Varuna Pumps. Our commitment to technical innovation led to the introduction of India's first oil\-based submersible pumps in 1991, and we have since expanded our portfolio to include over 1,000 models of energy\-efficient submersible pumps and motors.
 



 Key highlights of our operations include:
 


* Engineering Heritage: Over 80 years of expertise with a state\-of\-the\-art 100,000 sqm infrastructure.
* Market Leadership: Leading provider of agricultural and domestic pump sets, with an extensive reach of over 1,500 dealers and 500 plus authorized service centres across India.
* Global Presence: A government\-recognized Star Rated Export House exporting to more than 50 countries.
* Quality Standards: ISO 9001:2008 accredited production facility with CE and ISI certified products.
* Following our complete acquisition by KOEL in 2022, we continue to leverage our combined strengths to provide new\-age engineering solutions and expand our footprint in the global electric pump market. Feel free to peruse our website www.kirloskaroilengines.com for more details about our organization.



**AGM Sales (Small Engines/Gensets) \-Pune**




**Job Summary**

 :
 




 The incumbent will be responsible for Small Engines and Gensets and will drive volume growth and revenue expansion across the low\-to\-medium power segment (typically engines, portable generators and light industrial equipment). This role balances strategic channel management with active field\-level execution to penetrate retail, agricultural, construction, and residential markets.
 



**Key Responsibilities**




**1\. Channel Network Expansion \& Governance** 



* **Partner Recruitment:** 
 Identify, evaluate, and onboard high\-performing retail dealers, multi\-brand distributors, and sub\-dealers to eliminate white spaces in the assigned territory.
* **Dealer Performance Management:** 
 Design, implement, and track monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for channel partners.
* **Inventory \& Stock Liquidation:** 
 Monitor dealer stock levels to prevent over\-stocking or stock\-outs; implement liquidation strategies for slow\-moving models.
* **Dealer Governance:** 
 Conduct periodic audits of dealer facilities to ensure compliance with branding standards, credit terms, and service capabilities.
* **Relationship Programs:** 
 Launch dealer loyalty programs, annual meets, and incentive schemes to maximize mindshare over competitors.



**2\. Market Penetration \& Field Business Development** 



* **B2B Bulk Accounts:** 
 Pitch directly to regional institutional buyers, including construction contractors, event rental companies, telecom tower sub\-vendors, and agricultural cooperatives.
* **Localized Marketing (BTL):** 
 Conceptualize and execute Below\-the\-Line (BTL) marketing activities, including van activations, village roadshows, market\-yard demos, and trade expo participations.
* **Competitor Intelligence:** 
 Continuously map competitor pricing structures, dealer margins, credit terms, and product feature updates to adjust regional positioning.
* **Influencer Engagement:** 
 Build strong professional networks with local electrical technicians, mechanics, and small\-scale consultants who influence end\-user buying decisions.



**3\. Techno\-Commercial Operations \& Lifecycle Management** 



* **Technical Application Sizing:** 
 Guide clients and dealers through load calculations, advising on fuel choices (petrol, diesel, LPG, or CNG) and phase configurations (single vs. three\-phase).
* **Pricing \& Margin Management:** 
 Structure commercial quotes, manage localized discounting approvals, and maintain healthy gross margins within corporate boundaries
* **Tender \& Bid Operations:** 
 Source, track, and lead the technical and commercial submission process for local municipal, institutional, or government supply tenders.
* **Product Feedback Loop:** 
 Collect and relay field performance data, recurring product issues, and market demand for new features back to the R\&D and product manufacturing team



**4\. Supply Chain, Recovery \& After\-Sales Alignment** 



* **Sales \& Operations Planning (S\&OP):** 
 Provide accurate, data\-backed rolling sales forecasts to manufacturing and logistics teams to optimize supply chain timelines.
* **Credit Control \& Collections:** 
 Take absolute ownership of the accounts receivable ledger. Enforce strict credit limits and execute timely collections from dealers to minimize Day Sales Outstanding (DSO).
* **Service Ecosystem Support:** 
 Coordinate with the regional service team to ensure dealers maintain an adequate inventory of genuine spare parts and fast\-moving consumables.



**Required Qualifications and Experience:**




**Academic \& Professional Background** 



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. An MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, or International Business from a recognized institution is highly preferred.
* **Experience:** 
**Up to 12 years of core field experience in channel\-driven B2B or B2C sales of industrial capital goods.**
* **Domain Expertise:** 
**A proven track record in selling small internal combustion engines, portable generator sets, agricultural pump sets etc.**



**Technical Competencies** 



* **Small Engine Engineering:** 
 Deep understanding of 2\-stroke and 4\-stroke internal combustion engines, fuel injection systems, digital controllers, AVRs (Automatic Voltage Regulators), and alternator windings.
* **Channel Distribution Math:** 
 Mastery over distributor ROI calculations, primary vs. secondary sales dynamics, pipeline management, and trade margin structures.
* **ERP \& CRM Literacy:** 
 Proficiency in managing sales pipelines via CRMs (like Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho) and handling transactions via ERP systems (such as SAP or Oracle).



**Behavioral \& General Competencies** 



* **High Mobility:** 
 Willingness and physical stamina to travel extensively within the assigned territory (
 **up to 50–60% of the time** 
 ), often to rural or semi\-urban industrial belts.
* **Negotiation \& Hustle:** 
 Strong interpersonal, persuasion, and closing skills, with a natural ability to connect with grass\-roots dealers as well as corporate procurement heads.
* **Data\-Driven Mindset:** 
 Ability to analyze regional market metrics, demographic data, and sales trends to build actionable territory growth plans.



 Reporting Structure
 


* **Reports to:** 
 Business Head
* **Direct Reportees:** 
 Sales Team

 The Sales Support executive (Senior Manager) is a key contributor to Consulting growth, responsible for supporting sales pursuits, proposal execution, and commercial analysis across priority opportunities. This role works closely with Senior Managers, Partners, Account Leaders, and solution teams to improve pursuit effectiveness, deal quality, and pipeline discipline.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

+ Support end to end sales pursuits for consulting opportunities, including qualification, proposal development, pricing support, and approvals.
+ Partner with pursuit leaders to help shape deal strategy, solution positioning, and client value propositions.

+ Support leadership in pipeline reviews, forecast updates, and performance reporting.


* Team Collaboration \& Capability Building

+ Contribute to knowledge assets, playbooks, and reusable pursuit collateral.


**Experience**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 15\+ years of experience in consulting sales support, pursuit management, commercial advisory, or related roles.
* Hands on experience supporting medium to large consulting deals across technology, data, digital, or transformation programs.
* Experience working in a global / matrixed consulting environment is preferred.

* Strong understanding of the consulting sales lifecycle and proposal processes.
* Working knowledge of pricing, effort estimation, and commercial constructs.
* Ability to synthesize complex inputs into clear, client ready deliverables.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.


**Behavioural \& Leadership Skills**
* Detail oriented with strong execution discipline.
* Comfortable operating in fast paced, deadline driven pursuit environments.
* Collaborative team player with emerging leadership capabilities.
* High standards of quality, compliance, and professionalism.


**Education**

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

title: Community Lead (Managed Office)
description:
**About Us**
 Launched in 2017, WeWork India is one of India’s leading premium flexible workspace operators \- GPTW certified (Nov 2024 – Nov 2025, Dec 2025 – Dec 2026\). WeWork India has been the largest operator by total revenue for the past three fiscal years. Since its inception, WeWork India has expanded across 8 cities in Chennai, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, with 76 operational centres spanning 8\.2 million square feet (as of December 2025\).
   

  

 WeWork India has played a significant role in the growth of the flexible workspace sector and contributed to the evolution of its products and services, providing customized and curated solutions for various office space needs.
   

  

 For more information, please visit our website.
   

  

**About Job**
 As a Lead for our Managed Offices, you will own the end\-to\-end client, operational and commercial experience for a portfolio of Managed Office clients. You will lead seamless onboarding and operational handovers, strengthen client and member relationships, drive workplace experience and engagement, identify revenue opportunities, and ensure operational, financial and compliance standards are met.
   

  

 This role works closely with Sales, Projects, Operations, Client Solutions, Finance, Community and Events teams, and provides leadership to the Community Manager / MO POD where applicable, ensuring consistent delivery and continuous improvement across the portfolio.
   

  

**Skills \& Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, business administration, marketing, operations, or a related field.
* 5–8\+ years of experience in hospitality, co\-working, managed offices, workplace experience, operations, account management or customer\-facing roles; experience leading teams or portfolios is preferred.
* Strong client management, stakeholder management and commercial acumen.
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross\-functional projects, operational escalations and complex client requirements.
* Strong understanding of P\&L, billing, budgeting, revenue generation and business performance.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem\-solving abilities with attention to detail.
* Proficient in digital tools for ticketing, reporting, dashboards, communication and business reviews.
* A proactive, accountable and collaborative leader who can balance customer experience, operational excellence, people leadership and business outcomes. A passion for workplace experience, community.


**Responsibilities**
* Onboarding \& Transition Leadership
* Own the Managed Office onboarding and transition experience from pre\-move\-in through operational handover.
* Drive cross\-functional coordination with Sales, Projects and Operations to ensure a seamless client handover and readiness.
* Ensure 100% completion of the Building Opening Checklist within stipulated timelines.
* Coordinate with Operations and Client Solutions teams to identify, track and close post\-move\-in snags within agreed timelines, including closure of critical snags within 60 days.
* Use move\-in feedback and internal stakeholder feedback to improve onboarding and handover processes.
* Account Management \& Member Experience
* Own relationships with client SPOCs and key stakeholders, acting as the escalation point for Managed Office accounts.
* Drive exceptional day\-to\-day workplace experience while balancing member experience and facilities management.
* Plan and execute quarterly engagement activities for all Managed Office clients and measure outcomes through client/member feedback.
* Drive an average MO NPS of 75 or above across the portfolio.
* Conduct quarterly community and operations audits for Managed Offices and PCI, maintaining a minimum compliance score of 90%.
* Proactively identify service gaps, trends and opportunities to improve client satisfaction and retention.
* Operations, Compliance \& Service Delivery
* Ensure spaces remain operationally ready, well maintained and aligned to WeWork standards through structured reviews and audits.
* Own operational dashboards, ticketing, issue resolution, walkthroughs, audits and service reviews for the portfolio.
* Establish clear ownership and escalation mechanisms across Community, Operations, Projects, Finance and other internal teams.
* Ensure timely closure and communication of operational issues and client commitments.
* Drive standardisation and continuous improvement of operating processes, ROEs and SOPs.
* Revenue \& Commercial Management
* Own upsell and additional revenue opportunities across events, F\&B, community support, technology, parking, customisation and other services.
* Ensure Workplace Experience services are positioned and pitched to all relevant clients.
* Partner with Sales and internal teams to convert client needs intovalue\-added solutions and commercial opportunities.
* Own billing, P\&L and topline audit management for the Managed Office portfolio, including invoice review, budget finalisation and post\-sales P\&L management.
* Work in tandem with the BOB owner from the MO/GCC teams to ensure financial accuracy, visibility and performance.
* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
* Lead, coach and develop the MO Community / CM POD, including hiring, role design, performance management and growth planning for client\-billed headcount.
* Drive team engagement and wellbeing, with a focus on building a high\-performing and collaborative culture.
* Own team learning and development through LMS completion, endorsements, training and a quarterly L\&D calendar.
* Conduct quarterly IDP progress checks and reporting for the team.
* Build capability within the team to independently manage client relationships, workplace experience, events and operational delivery.
* Innovation, Workplace Experience \& Strategic Initiatives
* Drive continuous improvement through ROE/SOP 2\.0 and other process innovation initiatives.
* Create and develop an Event Management capability/wing to enable the team to drive events independently.
* Explore CXO/networking opportunities that strengthen client relationships and workplace experience.
* Develop PR\-as\-a\-service opportunities, including media time, interviews and podcasts, where relevant to clients and the business.
* Use client and operational insights to identify scalable solutions that improve experience and contribute to the bottom line.
* Communication, Reporting \& Stakeholder Management
* Provide structured portfolio updates covering client experience, operations, revenue, P\&L, risks, compliance and key actions.
* Maintain strong communication across Sales, Projects, Operations,
* Client Solutions, Finance, Community and Events teams.
* Present business reviews and insights to senior stakeholders and clients as required.
* Ensure timely escalation of risks, service issues and commercial opportunities.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 WeWork India is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our employees and members. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
   

  

 We expect all employees to embody our values and all aspects of employment including the decisions to hire and promote, are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.
   

  

 Our total rewards philosophy is aimed at providing compensation that is competitive, performance linked and helps us attract and retain the talent we need to drive our business forward and serve our members. As part of WeWork India, our commitment to you is that you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters collaboration, flexibility and inclusion.

**Company Description** 
 Divinelane is a fast\-growing company specializing in certified precious gemstones and genuine spiritual jewelry, combining traditional knowledge with modern expertise. The organization is committed to trust, quality, and expert astrological consultations, serving customers who value authenticity and spiritual guidance. With offices in Pune and Kolkata and an expanding network of retail stores, Divinelane offers a dynamic, growth\-oriented workplace. Team members have opportunities to contribute to the company’s expansion while building careers in spirituality\-focused retail, sales, and customer service. As the company grows, Divinelane welcomes driven professionals who want to be part of a purpose\-led brand.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Business Development Associate is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area. This position focuses on identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, including lead generation from walk\-in customers, referrals, and local partnerships. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting market research, understanding customer needs, presenting product offerings, and supporting sales targets for gemstones and spiritual jewelry. The role involves preparing and delivering presentations, engaging with customers in\-store, maintaining strong relationships, and collaborating with the retail and marketing teams to drive revenue growth. The associate will also track performance metrics, provide feedback on customer trends, and contribute to initiatives that enhance store visibility and brand awareness.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong communication skills for customer interaction, relationship\-building, and coordination with internal teams.
* Demonstrated ability in lead generation and follow\-up to convert prospects into loyal customers.
* Experience or aptitude in market research to understand customer segments, local trends, and competitor activity.
* Effective presentation skills, including preparing and delivering clear, engaging presentations and product demonstrations.
* Prior experience in retail sales, business development, or customer service, preferably in jewelry, luxury goods, or related sectors.
* Comfort working in an on\-site retail environment and meeting measurable targets and KPIs.
* Interest in spirituality, gemstones, or astrology and willingness to learn product and consultation details.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proficiency with basic office and CRM tools for tracking leads, sales activities, and customer data.

title: Distribution Executive - US Hotels
description:
**Location:** 
 Pune, Yerwada (work from office)
 



**Shift:** 
 5 PM – 3 AM IST (Monday to Friday)
 



**CTC:** 
 4\-6 LPA
 



  





**About Atica** 




 Atica is a tech\-first sales and revenue partner for hotels across the United States. We build the technology and run the commercial operation that grows revenue for 200\+ properties — sales, revenue management, distribution and digital — from independents to hotels operating under Marriott, IHG, Hyatt, Choice and Wyndham.
 



  





**Find out more:** 




 https://www.aticaglobal.com https://www.linkedin.com/company/atica\-global
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 Distribution is how Atica's hotels reach global B2B demand — through wholesalers and bed banks (Hotelbeds, WebBeds, Roibos, World2Meet, Travel Funders Network), travel management platforms (Engine, Bnberry) and redistribution partners (Nuitee).
 



  





 We are appointing a Manager to own that function end to end: the partner relationships, the commercial terms behind them, the channel and rate strategy across the portfolio, and the team that runs it.
 



  





 The mandate is to grow distribution's contribution to revenue, open the channels worth opening, close the ones that are not, and build the team and process behind it.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Partner strategy and commercial ownership
* Own every demand partner relationship and the commercial terms behind it: performance reviews, negotiation, escalation, and keeping Atica's hotels prioritised on their platforms.
* Segment the partner portfolio by fit and contribution, and decide where to invest and where to withdraw.
* Open new channels end to end evaluate the opportunity, negotiate terms, contract, and see the first properties live and producing.
* Grow partner penetration and revenue contribution across every active channel.



  





**Channel and rate strategy** 




  




* Decide the channel mix by property and market, and set rate positioning and allotment alongside Revenue Management, who own final pricing.
* Manage redistribution and leakage risk to protect rate integrity across the portfolio.
* Audit content, pricing and offers for accuracy and commercial compliance.



  





**Building the function** 




  




* Hire, develop and lead the Distribution team.
* Turn recurring problems into a standard process, and decide what gets automated.
* Work with Product and Tech on what gets built — workflow gaps, feature requests and internal tooling.



  





**Across the business** 




  




* Partner with Sales and Revenue Management on hotel\-level commercial objectives.
* Engage US hotel stakeholders, Directors of Sales, Revenue Managers directly.



  





**How You'll Be Measured** 



* Revenue contribution from distribution.
* Partner penetration across active channels.
* Strength of the partner ecosystem, including how quickly escalations are resolved.
* Percentage of hotels live on channel within SLA.
* The team's performance and delivery quality.



  





 In your first quarter you will have met every partner, formed a view on which relationships are underperforming, and made the case for where we invest. Within the year, distribution contributes materially more revenue, the channel mix reflects a deliberate strategy, and the team is one you have built.
 



  





**What You Bring** 



* 1\-3 years in hotel distribution, contracting, wholesale, global sales, or a comparable commercial role in hospitality or travel.
* Working knowledge of the wholesale channel: contracting, allotments, rate fencing, markup chains and redistribution. From either side of the table if you have contracted hotels for a bed bank, that translates directly.
* A negotiation track record. You have owned commercial conversations with partners and moved the terms.
* Clear, structured stakeholder communication, and the ability to push back when it matters.
* Evidence of building process operational complexity turned into something documented and repeatable.
* Ownership of an outcome rather than a workflow.



  





**Bonus Points** 



* People management experience.
* TMC or B2B2C channel exposure.
* Familiarity with the US hotel market.
* Please Note Before Applying

 1\. Respond to client enquiries and understand their requirements and expectations
   

 2\. Pitch products and solutions to prospective clients
   

 3\. Follow up with prospects and move opportunities toward conversion
   

 4\. Qualify leads and schedule meetings, demos, and sales discussions
   

 5\. Handle basic questions and objections and learn how to move prospects forward
   

 6\. Coordinate negotiations and support deal closures

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong Analytical Skills and ability to interpret market and sales data.
* Effective Communication skills for interactions with clients and internal teams.
* Lead Generation and Market Research skills to identify and qualify potential corporate customers.
* Customer Service skills to support a positive client experience before and after sales interactions.
* Interest in fashion, branding, and corporate merchandise.
* Ability to work on\-site in Pune Division and manage time efficiently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in basic office productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations, CRM is a plus).
* Currently pursuing or recently completed studies in Business, Marketing, Fashion Management, or a related field.


 Stipend Structure:
   

 Fixed pay: ₹ 13,000 \- 15,000 /month
   

 Incentive pay: ₹ 2,000 \- 5,000 /month
   

 What You'll Learn \& Gain:
   

  

 1\. Master the fundamentals of B2B sales and business development.
   

 2\. Learn prospecting, lead qualification, pitching, negotiation, and closing techniques.
   

 3\. Develop strong communication, persuasion, and relationship\-management skills.
   

 4\. Gain hands\-on experience with CRM systems, sales funnels, and conversion tracking.

 6\. Learn how sales teams coordinate with fulfillment and delivery teams to execute orders seamlessly.
   

 7\. Work closely with the Founder’s Office and experienced sales professionals.
   

 8\. Gain direct mentorship from senior leadership on B2B sales strategies.
   

 9\. Gain end\-to\-end, hands\-on experience in closing live B2B deals for UCTC's elite clientele.
   

 10\. Work closely with the Director on high\-value B2B deals.
   

 11\. Build the confidence and skills required to independently handle B2B sales conversations.
   

  

 The Outcome:
   

  

 In 6 months, you won't just have internship experience on your resume — you'll have hands\-on experience across the complete B2B sales cycle.
   

  

 If you are ambitious, confident, curious, and excited by the opportunity to engage with real businesses, solve client problems, and close real deals, this is an opportunity to learn from the ground up and build a strong foundation for a career in B2B Sales, Business Development, and Entrepreneurship.

title: Senior Business Development Associate
description:
***Minimac Systems***
 is a deep\-tech company building the circular economy for industrial lubricants.
 



  





 Our premise is simple: oil doesn't wear out, it just gets dirty. Since 2012, we have been extending the working life of industrial oils through miniaturised fluid\-treatment systems, oil condition monitoring and Recycling on Wheels, our mobile service that restores oil on site. Next is Lubricants as a Service, where customers pay for uptime, not litres.
 



  





 The numbers so far: 2,500\+ systems deployed, 2,200\+ industrial assets served and 14 million\+ litres of lubricant kept in productive use, for customers including NTPC, Adani Power, JSW Steel and Tata Steel.
 



 Minimac is backed by Rainmatter (Zerodha).
 



  





**Role Description** 




 Full\-time, on\-site role based in Pune.
 



  





 This is not a lead generation role. It is a strategy seat within business development, working directly with Minimac's leadership. You will research industries and large industrial groups, understand what their leadership teams care about, and align what Minimac offers with those priorities. The business follows from that work, usually over quarters, not weeks.
 



  





**What you will do:** 




 \- Research target sectors, large industrial groups and their priorities around cost, reliability and sustainability
 



 \- Build the business case for each opportunity: market sizing, cost\-benefit analysis and environmental impact
 



 \- Prepare CXO\-level engagements: briefing notes, strategy decks and proposals
 



 \- Work with our technical, operations and marketing teams so that what we propose is what we can deliver
 



 \- Support strategic partnerships, MOUs and new market entry, in India and overseas
 



 \- Carry a small number of strategic initiatives from research through to signed business
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business or a related field; an MBA is a plus
 



 \- Experience in strategy, consulting, key account management or strategic business development, ideally in B2B industrial sectors
 



 \- Strong research and analytical skills: market sizing, account and competitor analysis, business case building
 



 \- Ability to structure a problem and present it clearly to senior leadership, in writing and in person
 



 \- Commercial sense: you can see how insight turns into revenue, even when the cycle is long
 



 \- Comfortable with open\-ended problems, working independently and across teams
 



 \- Exposure to engineering, energy or sustainability is an advantage

**Team: 7 Corporate Event Planners \+ 1 Operations Executive** 




**Working Hours: Aligned to UAE business hours** 




**Weekly Off: Any 2 days of the week** 




  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for a Team Lead to lead our corporate events team and own its commercial performance.
 



 You will manage 7 planners and 1 operations executive, with your primary focus on hitting revenue and margin targets, improving conversion, coaching planners to sell better, and maintaining high delivery standards.
 



 This is a player\-coach role. You will personally stay close to important opportunities and client situations while helping the team consistently perform at a higher level.
 



 You don't need to build a large operations function. You need to build a high\-performing sales and event\-planning team.
 



  





**Key Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Own Team Revenue \& Performance** 




 • Own monthly team targets for revenue, gross margin, conversion and productivity.
 



 • Break targets into clear individual planner goals and track performance through live dashboards.
 



 • Identify performance gaps early and put corrective actions in place.
 



 • Run regular pipeline, conversion and performance reviews.
 



 • Escalate risks with a diagnosis and proposed solution, not just the problem.
 



**2\. Coach the Team to Sell Better** 




 • Coach planners on qualification, discovery, proposals, pricing, negotiation, follow\-up and closing.
 



 • Review live opportunities and help unblock difficult deals.
 



 • Identify what separates high performers from low performers and replicate those behaviours across the team.
 



 • Develop underperforming planners through clear expectations, coaching and follow\-through.
 



 • Build a culture of ownership, urgency and commercial discipline.
 



**3\. Stay Close to Clients \& Sales** 




 • Personally handle selected high\-value opportunities and important client escalations.
 



 • Support the team on complex negotiations and strategic accounts.
 



 • Ensure planners are selling profitable events, not just chasing topline revenue.
 



 • Maintain strong client relationships and drive repeat business.
 



**4\. Maintain Event\-Planning Quality** 




 • Use your event and venue expertise to challenge proposals, commercials and delivery plans where required.
 



 • Help planners anticipate operational risks before they reach the client.
 



 • Ensure strong handover from sale through event delivery and closure.
 



**5\. Help us Improve Through AI \& Product** 




 • Drive adoption of our AI tools across the team.
 



 • Identify where AI, automation or better workflows can improve sales productivity and conversion.
 



 • Share structured feedback with Product based on real planner and client problems.
 



 • Help the team adapt quickly as our systems and workflows evolve.
 



  





**Must Have** 




 • 6–10 years of total experience
 



 • 2–3\+ years managing a team of 6\+
 



 • Experience in corporate events, MICE, hospitality, hotel banquets, event production, travel, events agencies or another relevant customer\-facing commercial environment
 



 • Proven experience personally owning a sales/revenue target
 



 • Experience coaching and improving sales performance within a team
 



 • Strong understanding of revenue, gross margin and conversion
 



 • Strong spoken and written English
 



 • Comfortable working with dashboards, CRM and performance data
 



 • Strong problem\-solving mindset and comfort operating without a perfect playbook
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 • UAE / GCC / international B2B client exposure
 



 • Experience leading event planners or corporate\-event sales teams
 



 • Strong venue, supplier or MICE network
 



 • Experience using AI meaningfully in day\-to\-day work
 



 • Experience working with Product, technology or automation teams
 



 • Experience building or improving sales processes and SOPs

title: AO/RFP Writer - Fixed Income
description:
**Job Description**
*AllianceBernstein’s Client Group has a presence in the Americas, Europe, Asia and Australia, and is composed of five main areas:*
* Sales \& Client Services works with financial intermediaries and institutions to offer diversified investment solutions that help clients build and preserve their wealth
* Business Development is a conduit to the firm’s investment teams and supports our clients and internal business partners through investment\-platform and product content, messaging, competitive analysis and education
* Product Strategy \& Development designs, develops and manages the firm’s global lineup of investment services and considers clients’ evolving needs to identify new opportunities
* Marketing promotes the firm and its services by creating, packaging and distributing content and messaging to engage diverse audiences through digital platforms and initiatives, strategic campaigns, and events
* Business Transformation looks to evolve and scale our business, leveraging digital and data, to drive top\-line growth and improve profitability


**What You’ll Do**
*AllianceBernstein’s Request for Proposal (RFP) team is in search of a RFP writer to contribute to business development and client service through the completion of RFPs, RFIs, as well as some due diligence requests for AllianceBernstein’s Fixed Income Strategies. The Writer will specialize in writing RFPs for our Fixed Income Strategies in a timely and accurate manner, while also contributing, where needed, to the completion of other projects and requests. The Writer will be expected to be able to work effectively with the firm’s Senior RFP Writers and Management Team, Product Managers and Portfolio Managers, as well as our Sales Teams, to write and maintain (keep updated) original and technical product\-specific content to support our Fixed Income platform, and, importantly, to be able to effectively customize that content for specific sales situations as needed.*
*This position will provide an opportunity to develop knowledge in the entire new business development process: from the initial screening of an RFP, to the organization and project management of an RFP, to the actual content creation and updating of RFP language and then, finally, to the follow\-up and tracking of our RFPs. The candidate will be expected to handle a high volume of requests simultaneously and productively. Projects will be primarily related to new business opportunities, as well as some client servicing\-related including Onboarding Questionnaires and client Due Diligence Questionnaires.*
**Specific Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Write a high volume of RFPs for Fixed Income strategies and support other asset classes as needed.
* Liaise with various departments throughout the firm to collect information needed to respond to requests, including but not limited to portfolio management, product management/marketing, legal, operations, AUM reporting and performance.
* Create and maintain RFP language and content for assigned strategies of coverage, including investment process, research process, team information, and competitive advantages.
* Maintain consistent product messaging and updated product language in our RFP database.
* Collaborate directly with Product Managers, Portfolio Managers, Research Analysts, Traders, and others to update existing RFP language and develop new language.
* Customize final documents to reflect a nuanced and targeted response to the specific sales opportunity.
* Handle follow\-up work associated with RFPs moving to the next phase: coordinating answers, additional information, etc.
* Oversee production of final proposals (formatting, technical editing and reproduction).
* Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously to meet strict deadlines.
* Field ad\-hoc questions from our Client Response Center Team daily, as needed.


**What We’re Looking For**
*The ideal candidate should have:*
* Knowledge of the broader fixed income market and the asset management industry.
* Detail\-oriented with excellent project management and organizational skills; able to prioritize work and handle multiple tasks to ensure that complex projects are completed by deadline, with interim review steps incorporated.
* Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills as well as the ability to work independently and as part of a team in a large global organization.
* Demonstrated desire and ability to learn technical info, including philosophy, research and investment processes of our products.
* Demonstrated initiative and good judgment as well as the ability to work well under pressure and with time constraints.
* Interest in and ability to interact directly and effectively with Sales Advisors, Portfolio Managers and other investment professionals.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Word, and possess the ability to quickly master internal systems and applications.
* Experience: 5\-8 years of RFP and industry experience required. Direct experience with Fixed Income RFP content is required.
* Education: CFA Level I cleared \& MBA Finance


**About AB**
*We are a leading global investment management firm offering high\-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private\-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work.*
*Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought\-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us!*
