title: Spare Parts Package Coordinator
description:
Job Title
   

  

 Spare Parts Package Coordinator
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Title \- Spare Parts Package Coordinator
   

  

**Job Description**
 Your department
   

  

 The Global Spare Parts Department is part of the Business Unit Supply. The Global Spare Parts team is end\-to\-end responsible for the spare parts activities for Vanderlande’s Customer Centers (CC’s) and their customers. Global Spare Parts department is creating a Center of Competence in our Global Capability Center at Pune, India. Global Spare Parts is organized in three departments.
   

  

 Global Spare Parts
   

  

* Spare Parts Marketing manages the spare parts product portfolio to improve the parts value proposition to the Vanderlande CC’s and Customers. The activities include Product Life Cycle management with a strong focus on digitalization and B2B e\-commerce. The team manages the global pricing, product content and builds a strong relation with in\- and external stakeholders.
* Global Support supports the global customer base with spare parts offerings throughout the life\-time of the material handling assets. This includes the development of initial spare parts packages and day to day technical and commercial spare parts support. The department advises customers to optimize the on\-site stock availability.
* Spare Parts Logistics manages the central parts warehouse and is responsible for all in\- and outbound warehouse activities. They manage stock\-levels, lead\-times and on\-time shipment and delivery of parts from suppliers and deliveries to the global Vanderlande customer base


 Your position
   

  

 You will be the first point of contact for the customers’ spare parts related questions and requests. You will own the ordering process and will keep the customer up to date with the delivery information.
   

  

 Where necessary, you will also check the technical documentation (Bill of Material) in order to find out what parts are needed for the customer.
   

  

 Tasks And Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage customer\-specific spare parts package activities from project initiation through completion.
* Collect, validate, and maintain supplier spare parts data, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
* Identify portfolio gaps, create missing material master records, prepare BIT files, and maintain installed base information.
* Develop and maintain Bills of Material (BOMs), spare parts package structures, and related master data.
* Prepare preliminary budgets and customer quotations using SPARQ, FileMaker (CAP), SCCT, and manual quotation processes.
* Process SQ quotations, spare parts orders, SD/OD orders, and associated project documentation.
* Plan and monitor spare parts deliveries, ensuring timely execution and follow\-up within JDE.
* Partner with Project Managers to align spare parts deliverables with project schedules and implementation milestones.
* Prioritize project activities, monitor progress, and ensure on\-time completion of assigned deliverables.
* Serve as the primary liaison for regional Spare Parts Coordinators, promoting effective collaboration and knowledge sharing.
* Standardize global spare parts processes, templates, and governance while supporting continuous improvement initiatives.
* Drive operational excellence through process optimization, automation, and best\-practice implementation.
* Collaborate with Service, Sales, Supply Chain, and Project teams to deliver customer\-focused lifecycle support solutions.

title: Category Manager - Orthopedic Power Systems
description:
Category Manager \- Orthopedic Power Systems
   

 Location: Pune, Maharashtra
   

 Employment Type: Full\-time
   

 Travel: Extensive domestic travel; occasional international travel
   

  

 1\. Role Purpose
   

  

 The Category Manager – Orthopedic Power Systems will be responsible for building, managing, and growing Manman’s Orthopedic Power Systems business as an independent strategic category.
   

  

 The role will own the complete category lifecycle — from market intelligence, product strategy and portfolio planning to pricing, sales enablement, channel development, marketing, product launches, inventory planning and profitability.
   

  

 The individual will act as the central interface between R\&D, Engineering, Production, Quality \& Regulatory, Sales, Service, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain, ensuring that the Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio remains clinically relevant, commercially competitive and financially successful.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should combine strong orthopedic product knowledge with commercial and business\-development capability.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 2\. Key Responsibilities
   

  

 A. Category Strategy \& Business Ownership
   

  

 \- Develop and execute the annual and long\-term strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 \- Own category revenue, gross margin, market share and growth objectives.
   

 \- Develop annual business plans covering:
   

 \- Revenue
   

 \- Unit volumes
   

 \- ASP
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- Channel mix
   

 \- Geographic expansion
   

 \- Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and applications for orthopedic power systems.
   

 \- Develop category growth strategies for India and selected international markets.
   

 \- Track competitors, pricing, technology, product launches and market positioning.
   

 \- Identify gaps in Manman’s portfolio and recommend new products or product variants.
   

  

 B. Product Portfolio Management
   

  

 Own the complete Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio, including relevant:
   

  

 \- High\-speed drill systems
   

 \- Large\-bone systems
   

 \- Small\-bone systems
   

 \- Saw systems
   

 \- Oscillating/sagittal saws
   

 \- Reciprocating saws
   

 \- Shaver systems
   

 \- Endoscopic burr systems
   

 \- Attachments
   

 \- Handpieces
   

 \- Accessories
   

 \- Consumables
   

 \- Batteries and chargers
   

 \- Related service and AMC offerings
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Define product positioning and target customer for each product.
   

 \- Maintain the product portfolio and product lifecycle.
   

 \- Identify products requiring upgrades, replacement or discontinuation.
   

 \- Develop product roadmaps in coordination with R\&D and Engineering.
   

 \- Define product specifications based on market and clinical requirements.
   

 \- Gather voice\-of\-customer and surgeon feedback.
   

 \- Convert clinical requirements into clear product requirements for Engineering/R\&D.
   

  

 C. Product Development \& New Product Introduction
   

  

 \- Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for new products.
   

 \- Work with Engineering/R\&D on product development priorities.
   

 \- Coordinate prototype evaluation with surgeons and key opinion leaders.
   

 \- Organize clinical/user evaluations and product trials.
   

 \- Coordinate with Quality \& Regulatory for required documentation and approvals.
   

 \- Develop launch plans for new products.
   

 \- Establish product readiness gates before commercial launch.
   

 \- Coordinate first production, field trials and commercial release.
   

  

 D. Pricing \& Commercial Management
   

  

 \- Develop product pricing strategy based on:
   

 \- Manufacturing cost
   

 \- Landed cost
   

 \- Competitor pricing
   

 \- Clinical value
   

 \- Channel margins
   

 \- Customer segment
   

 \- Market positioning
   

 \- Recommend MRP, distributor/dealer pricing and institutional pricing.
   

 \- Monitor discounting and price realization.
   

 \- Develop tender and institutional pricing frameworks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve category gross margin.
   

 \- Monitor profitability by product, customer segment and channel.
   

  

 E. Sales Enablement
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales team to increase conversion and category penetration.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop sales presentations and product literature.
   

 \- Create product comparison sheets.
   

 \- Develop competitive battle cards.
   

 \- Conduct regular product training for sales teams and distributors.
   

 \- Train sales personnel on clinical applications and product positioning.
   

 \- Support major customer meetings, product demonstrations and evaluations.
   

 \- Participate in important tenders and institutional negotiations.
   

 \- Support the sales team in converting strategic accounts.
   

  

 F. Surgeon \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement
   

  

 Build strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinical experts.
   

  

 \- Identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
   

 \- Conduct surgeon feedback programs.
   

 \- Organize product demonstrations and workshops.
   

 \- Coordinate product evaluations at hospitals.
   

 \- Gather structured feedback on product performance and clinical usability.
   

 \- Identify emerging surgical techniques and applications.
   

 \- Develop surgeon advisory panels where appropriate.
   

 \- Convert clinical feedback into product\-development priorities.
   

  

 G. Channel \& Market Development
   

  

 \- Develop strategies for direct, dealer and distributor channels.
   

 \- Identify and onboard suitable channel partners.
   

 \- Define territory\-wise category opportunities.
   

 \- Develop distributor sales targets and business plans.
   

 \- Monitor distributor inventory and secondary sales.
   

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.

title: Sr. Principal Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
   

  

**The Role**
 AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double\-digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.
   

  

 As a Sr. Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
   

  

 In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.


 What You'll Need
   

  

* 14 \+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.


 Regional travel up to 35%.

title: Application/Sys Sales Eng II
description:
**Job Description**
 The Application Engineer is primarily responsible for preparation of technical and commercial customer proposals during the sales process. He/She will exhibit genuine interest in solving work problems through proactively asking questions, clearly communicating and collaborating both internally and externally to grow the business. In addition, the Application Engineer is responsible for understanding our competition and customers and showing initiative to learn and continuously improve company processes.
   

  

 The Application Engineer assists in developing and maintaining tools used in the front\-end engineering and quotation process. These tools include Excel spreadsheets, Word documents, and Access databases, as well as our ERP database. Also, would assist in organizing and modification of control system drawings, sales literature and promotional documentation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work to distill and organize technical and commercial proposal data into spreadsheets and word documents and/or databases.
* Analyze project requirements and gather necessary information to prepare proposals.
* Work to get external offers from possible sub\-vendors and evaluate which is technically and commercially adequate as part of CCC solution.
* Prepare comprehensive technical proposals, including scope of work, project timelines, and cost estimates.
* Conduct technical research and feasibility studies to support proposal development.
* Ensure that proposals comply with company standards and meet client specifications.
* Collaborate with the procurement team to obtain accurate pricing and availability of materials and services.
* Review and revise proposals based on client feedback and requirements.
* Coordinate with project managers and engineers to ensure a smooth transition from proposal to project execution.
* Participate in pre\-bid meetings and technical discussions with clients.
* Stay updated on industry trends, market conditions, and competitors’ offerings to enhance proposal competitiveness.
* Assist in preparing presentation materials for client meetings and bid presentations.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple proposals simultaneously.
* Attention to detail and a high level of accuracy in proposal preparation.
* Provide fundamental technical support for the sales process, and specific assigned front\-end engineering projects.
* Provide technical analysis, troubleshooting and solutions
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external contacts.
* Maintain sensitive and confidential information regarding company information.
* Respond to change productively and handle other duties as required.
* Follow all company safety policies and procedures.


**Qualifications**
**EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE**
* University Degree in Engineering
* more than 7 years of experience in control systems engineering or related field or related experience and/or equivalent combination of education and experience


**Knowledge \& Skills**
* Have analytical skills to recognize patterns in data, information or events to draw logical conclusions and make recommendations for action.
* Ability to efficiently use all Microsoft Office products.
* Ability to operate test equipment and obtain measurements and data.
* To use established computer programs to input data, run queries and perform analysis.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Provide limited technical knowledge in specific areas of engineering aspects.
* Demonstrated ability to continuously learn.
* Ability to read, speak, and write in English required.


**WORKING CONDITIONS**
 Work Environment: Proposal engineers typically work in an office setting, collaborating with various teams and departments within the organization. The work environment is professional and focused, with a mix of individual tasks and team meetings.
   

  

 Office Hours: The standard working hours for a Proposal Engineer are typically Monday to Friday (8 hours daily),. However, some flexibility in working hours may be required to accommodate client deadlines or project requirements.
   

  

 Travel: Proposal engineers may be required to travel occasionally to attend client meetings, pre\-bid discussions, industry conferences or to conduct site survey. The extent of travel may vary based on the nature of the projects and client locations.
   

  

 Deadlines: Proposal engineers often work under deadlines and face time\-sensitive fast track bids. This can lead to periods of high workload, especially when multiple proposals need to be prepared simultaneously. Effective time management and the ability to work well under pressure are essential skills for this role.
   

  

 Collaboration: Proposal engineers collaborate closely with sales teams, project managers, engineers, and other internal stakeholders. This involves effective communication, coordination, and the ability to work as part of a team.
   

  

**Additional Technical Knowledge \& Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Turbomachinery Control Systems, including compressor, gas turbine, and steam turbine control philosophies and operational requirements.
* Experience with Anti\-Surge Control (ASC) systems for centrifugal compressors, including surge curve interpretation, control valve sizing concepts, performance monitoring, and tuning methodologies.
* Knowledge of Gas Turbine Control Systems, including startup/shutdown sequences, fuel control, combustion management, load control, speed control, emissions control, and protection systems.
* Knowledge of Steam Turbine Control Systems, including governor control, speed/load control, extraction and admission control, overspeed protection, turbine supervision, and trip systems.
* Understanding of Compressor Control Applications, including capacity control, recycle control, performance optimization, and machinery protection integration.
* Familiarity with industry standards and practices related to turbomachinery control, machinery protection, and process automation.
* Knowledge of PLC systems, including system architecture, controller configuration, I/O design, redundancy concepts, and industrial automation applications.
* Experience with major automation platforms such as Allen\-Bradley (Rockwell), Siemens, Schneider Electric, GE, Honeywell, Yokogawa, Emerson DeltaV, and ABB is preferred.
* Knowledge of industrial communication protocols including Modbus RTU/TCP, OPC UA, OPC DA, Ethernet/IP, ProfiNet, ProfiBus, Foundation Fieldbus, HART, and Serial Communications.
* Understanding of control system networking, cybersecurity fundamentals, industrial Ethernet infrastructure, and remote monitoring solutions.
* Ability to analyze process dynamics and develop control strategies, perform control loop tuning, and support system troubleshooting and optimization activities.
* Ability to interpret P\&IDs and PFDs, control narratives, cause \& effect diagrams, instrument data sheets, and control system architecture drawings.
* Ability to perform technical evaluations of customer specifications and develop compliant automation and turbomachinery control system solutions.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.
   

  

 Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Job Title: Inside Sales Team Leader
   

  

 Location: Pune
   

  

 Previous Experience: 3\-4 years of experience in leading Inside sales, account management, or business development.
   

  

 Shift Timings: 6:00 PM to 3:00 AM/8:00 PM to 5:00 AM \- Should be willing to work from the office. Willingness to work from office and stretch when business requires.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Job Overview:
   

  

 The Inside Sales Leader is responsible for leading a team of Inside Sales Associates (ISAMs) to drive account growth, manage customer relationships, and ensure efficient sales pipeline management. This role requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, and the ability to coach and develop team members. The Team Leader will collaborate with branches, field representatives, and internal teams to align sales strategies, drive sales campaigns, and improve overall team performance. Additionally, the Team Leader will own the budget for the respective region and territories, manage Accounts Receivable (AR) due on accounts, and analyze performance, including corrective actions for lost accounts or underperformance. The role also requires strong technical sales skills to effectively communicate and sell complex products/services to customers
   

  

 Roles And Responsibilities
   

  

* Team Leadership \& Performance Management:


 oLead, mentor, and develop a team of Inside Sales Associates, ensuring they meet sales targets, maintain strong customer relationships, and adhere to company standards.
   

  

 oSet clear expectations for team performance, implementing corrective actions and training initiatives to drive both individual and team success.
   

  

 oFoster a collaborative and high\-performing culture, providing regular feedback, coaching, and mentoring.
   

  

 oConduct performance evaluations and identify growth opportunities for team members through structured development programs.
   

  

* Driving Sales Campaigns: Lead and execute sales campaigns within the assigned region, collaborating with the team to implement strategies that drive revenue and growth.
* Account \& Pipeline Management: Oversee and support the team in managing assigned accounts, ensuring that each account is touched quarterly for relationship\-building and account growth.
* AR Management: Ensure proper follow\-up and management of Accounts Receivable (AR) due on accounts, coordinating with the finance team to resolve payment issues promptly.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as the key liaison between the inside sales team, branches, and field representatives, ensuring alignment of sales strategies and optimizing customer engagement.
* Customer\-Centric Approach: Guide the team to provide exceptional service, foster long\-term relationships with customers, and proactively address their evolving needs. Ability to handle customer escalations and resolve conflicts in a calm, professional manner.
* Lost Reason Analysis \& Corrective Actions: Analyze lost sales or account closures, identify key reasons for losses, and implement corrective actions to improve retention, reduce churn, and enhance conversion rates.
* Process Improvement \& Strategy Execution: Identify opportunities for process improvement, introduce best practices, and ensure the execution of sales strategies to achieve team and organizational goals.
* Project Participation: Actively engage in cross\-functional projects that contribute to team performance improvements and alignment with business objectives.
* CRM \& Reporting: Ensure accurate tracking of sales activities, customer interactions, and team progress through CRM tools, providing regular updates and performance reports to leadership.

title: Sr Estimator
description:
**Responsibilities**
 Senior Estimator
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Senior Estimator is responsible for leading the development, estimation, and delivery of high\-quality technical and commercial proposals for strategic Integrated Control \& Safety System (ICSS) projects. The role provides end\-to\-end ownership of the proposal process, including solution development, cost estimation, risk assessment, stakeholder coordination, vendor engagement, governance approvals, proposal submission, and post\-bid support.
   

  

 Working closely with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and external partners, the Senior Estimator develops competitive, compliant, and profitable solutions that maximize customer value while supporting Honeywell's strategic growth objectives. The role requires strong technical expertise, commercial acumen, leadership capability, and the ability to manage complex bid activities across multiple stakeholders and regions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**Proposal Leadership and Strategy**
* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional proposal teams to develop accurate, compliant, and commercially competitive proposals within established timelines.
* Own the end\-to\-end proposal development process, from opportunity qualification through submission and post\-bid support.
* Participate in bid/no\-bid reviews and contribute to proposal strategy, risk mitigation, and win themes.
* Prepare and maintain comprehensive Proposal Execution Plans, including resource allocation, deliverables, responsibilities, milestones, and submission schedules.
* Lead the preparation and successful submission of large\-scale, complex proposals and tenders, including multi\-country and international projects.


**Technical Solution Development**
* Analyze customer requirements, requests for quotation, specifications, and supporting documents to develop technically compliant and commercially viable solutions.
* Analyze, design, and develop end\-to\-end ICSS solutions, with a primary focus on Distributed Control Systems (DCS), SCADA, Process Safety Systems, PLCs, and associated automation technologies.
* Develop innovative technical and commercial alternatives that optimize competitiveness, profitability, risk profile, and customer value.
* Ensure proposed solutions align with customer requirements and Honeywell strategic initiatives, including market verticalization, new product introduction, and other growth priorities.


**Estimating and Commercial Management**
* Prepare accurate cost estimates and commercial proposals for greenfield, brownfield, modernization, and service projects using approved methodologies, tools, and procedures.
* Conduct commercial reviews to identify risks, opportunities, cost drivers, and margin improvement initiatives.
* Develop pricing strategies that balance market competitiveness, customer value, and business profitability objectives.
* Use applicable systems and tools to maintain accurate documentation of estimates, proposals, assumptions, exclusions, and supporting information.


**Vendor and Stakeholder Management**
* Coordinate with Procurement and supporting functions to obtain technical and commercial quotations from suppliers, subcontractors, and third\-party vendors.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Finance, Procurement, suppliers, and customers to support proposal success.
* Collaborate with regional and global teams to develop optimized technical and commercial solutions.


**Proposal Governance and Compliance**
* Ensure complete and compliant responses to customer bid packages, including all required technical submissions, commercial documents, scope of supply, and supporting information.
* Prepare and submit required approval documentation in accordance with Honeywell governance requirements.
* Ensure proposals comply with customer specifications, company standards, contractual requirements, and applicable regulations.


**Post\-Bid Support and Continuous Improvement**
* Support customer technical and commercial clarification activities following proposal submission and update proposals as required.
* Continuously enhance knowledge of Honeywell solutions, industry trends, competitor offerings, and market developments.
* Drive standardization, process improvement, estimating best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives across the estimating community.
* Provide coaching, guidance, and mentoring to junior estimators and proposal engineers.


**Qualifications**
**Key Skills and Qualifications** 
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.


**Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in Process Automation, Industrial Control Systems, or related engineering solutions.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in estimating, proposal management, bid execution, or commercial engineering roles.
* Proven experience successfully delivering complete proposals for large and complex projects, including international opportunities.


**Technical Competencies**
* Strong understanding of process industries, including Oil \& Gas, Refining, Petrochemicals, LNG, Power, Mining, Metals, and Minerals.
* Demonstrated technical expertise in Industrial Control Systems, including DCS, SCADA, PLC, and Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS).
* Experience with Honeywell automation solutions, including Experion, Safety Manager, FSC, and related technologies, is highly desirable.


**Leadership and Commercial Skills**
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including project costing, pricing strategy, margin analysis, and risk assessment.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, negotiation, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong technical and integrative thinking skills, with the ability to develop innovative, customer\-focused solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all organizational levels.


**We Value**
* Customer\-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional value and service.
* Strategic thinking and strong business acumen.
* Strong technical aptitude and systems\-thinking capability.
* Knowledge of Honeywell's automation portfolio and competitive industry solutions.
* Ability to drive results and perform effectively in a fast\-paced bid environment.
* Strong planning, organization, and prioritization skills.
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to work independently with limited direction while effectively leading project teams.
* Continuous learning mindset and commitment to professional development.
* Mentoring and coaching capability to support team development.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and related


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Head of Sales
description:
**Job Title: Head of Sales** 




**Location\- Pune, Bavdhan, (Onsite)** 




**Exp\- 8–12 years in residential real estate sales leadership, with at least one full cycle of a Rs. 300 Cr\+ project run end\-to\-end.** 




  





**SALES HEAD** 




  





**We're not hiring someone to manage a sales team. We're hiring someone to build one — from the ground up, around a new\-to\-market product: The Living Blueprint, India's first longevity\-led residential development.** 




  





**The playbook of buying leads, handing them to closers and hoping ATL spend converts doesn't work for a product this deep. We need a specialised, data\-driven, empathetic sales machine, built on the Predictable Revenue model — prospecting, qualification and closing run as three distinct systems, backed by CRM discipline, ICP rigour and SOPs that scale. Get this right at GLC, and the same playbook powers our next 30 million sq ft of TLB launches across Pune, Mumbai, Nagpur and NCR.** 




  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 




  





**• The Sourcing Engine — Build and lead the SDR function, own the Ideal Client Profile, and run ATL, BTL and Channel Partner sourcing to deliver 6,000 qualified leads and 600 site walk\-ins a month.** 




  





**• The Qualification \& Nurture Layer — Build the MRR (qualifying) team, design the nurture flow that moves cold leads to sales\-ready, and fix the layer where most of today's pipeline is lost.** 




  





**• The Closing System — Design scripts and the "Objection Aikido" rebuttal library, and train Account Executives in empathetic, NLP\-informed selling that converts walk\-ins to bookings at 11%\+, with discount discipline held inside 6% of agreement value.** 




  





**• The Data \& SOP Backbone — Own the CRM end\-to\-end, build the MIS/analytics function, and implement the SOPs (including the 19\-touch connect system) that make the whole funnel observable and improvable, weekly.** 




  





**Plus full P\&L ownership of GLC sales, team leadership across sourcing, MRR, AE and support functions, Channel Partner strategy, and direct, weekly access to the Partner and Owner — no layers, no filtered reporting.** 




  





**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




  





**We're hiring for the system\-building skill, not the industry on your resume. Real estate experience helps, but it isn't required — the right candidate could be coming from a completely different category.** 




  





**•12\+ years in senior sales leadership, having personally built and scaled a sales function for a large\-ticket, high\-consideration offering. Residential real estate is welcome but not required — we're equally open to wellness, hospitality, luxury automotive, private banking, or a comparable premium/category\-creating business, provided you've operated at a comparable scale (ideally the equivalent of a Rs. 300 Cr\+ project or portfolio).** 




**• Has built a sales system before, not just inherited one — can walk us through the org chart, CRM stack, script library and SOPs they personally designed.** 




**• Fluent in CRM as an operating discipline (HubSpot, Salesforce, LeadSquared, Sell.Do, Kylas, Zoho or similar) — the platform matters less than the discipline.** 




**• Reads dashboards and argues from data, not gut feel.** 




**• Personally credible with a longevity and wellness proposition — fitness\-oriented, curious about the science, respectful of an educated, long\-cycle buyer.** 




  





**This role is 20% closing, 80% building. It's not for the star closer who can't describe a repeatable system, the operator who thinks every gap needs a bigger ATL cheque, the GM who runs on WhatsApp and spreadsheets, or the closer who wins with pressure tactics and fake urgency. It is for someone willing to sit on the site\-office floor with the SDRs at 9am and role\-play scripts with the MRRs at 6pm — hands in the machine, for at least the first 12 months.** 




  





**WHAT WE OFFER** 




  





**Fixed compensation benchmarked at the 75th percentile of premium residential Sales Head roles in Pune/MMR, outcome\-linked variable pay (tied to booking value, walk\-in delivery, discount discipline and CP satisfaction — not activity metrics), and a long\-term, project\-completion incentive tied to the B7 sell\-out and B8 launch, paid over 24 months.**

title: Sales Advisor
description:
**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**




 As a Sales Advisor at H\&M, you’ll play a key role in creating an outstanding customer experience. You’ll welcome customers, guide them through your store, and support them in finding what they need while showcasing our products. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.
   

  





 You will:
   

  





 → Share your fashion and product knowledge to help customers make informed choices.
   

  





 → Collaborate with your team to deliver exceptional service at every step of the customer journey.
   

  





 → Ensure the sales floor and back of house are well\-stocked, organized, and inviting.
   

  





 → Support with opening and closing of the store.
   

  





 → Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.
   

  





  

  





**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**




 Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.
   

  





**WHO YOU ARE**




 We are looking for people with…
   

  





 → Experience in customer service within fashion, retail, or similar fields.
   

  





 And people who are…
   

  





 → Passionate about fashion and delivering an exceptional in\-store experience while promoting our products and driving sales.
   

  





 → Thriving in collaborative and dynamic environments.
   

  





 → Communicative, creative, curious to work with store technology, with a strong eagerness to learn and develop.
   

  





 → Flexible and action oriented.
   

  





  

  





**WHO WE ARE**




 H\&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.
   

  





 WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE At H\&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
   

  





 · We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability.
   

  





 · We pride ourselves on being a values\-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years.
   

  





 · We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
   

  





 · You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits.
   

  





 · We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness for self and family.
   

  





 · You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H\&M group.
   

  





 · We offer 5 days of working in a week to have great work life balance.
   

  





  

  





**JOIN US**




 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
   

  





 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
   

  





 \* Store roles assessment:
   

  





 To manage the high volume of applications for the Sales Advisor role, we use an online assessment method for skills\-based recruitment within some of our stores. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies predefined criteria set by H\&M Group.
   

  





 After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions. If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment\_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact on your application.
   

  





 For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.
   

  





 \*\* We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

 This is a full\-time position for our store in westend mall Pune. The position reports to the Department Manager.

title: Channel Sales Manager
description:
**Role – CHANNEL SALES HEAD** 




**Company:** 
 Joy N Crew Vacations LLP
 



**Location:** 
 Pune \| Work from Office
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Preferred Experience:** 
 8–12 years in Travel \& Tourism, including at least 3 years managing channel sales or B2B sales teams
 



**Industry:** 
 Travel \& Tourism experience is mandatory
 



**Compensation: Up to** 
**9 LPA** 




**Role Overview** 




 Joy N Crew Vacations LLP is looking for an experienced
 **Channel Sales Head** 
 to build, expand, and manage its travel agent and distribution partner network.
 



 The position will own revenue growth through travel agents, tour operators, travel consultants, and other approved business partners. The ideal candidate will bring strong travel trade relationships, proven partner acquisition skills, and experience converting a channel network into consistent, profitable bookings.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Channel Strategy and Business Growth** 



* Develop and execute the channel sales strategy for domestic and international holiday products.
* Set monthly, quarterly, and annual targets for channel revenue, profitability, partner acquisition, and activation.
* Identify priority markets and territories based on travel demand and business potential.
* Build a balanced partner portfolio to reduce dependence on a small number of agents.
* Develop territory\-wise growth plans and review performance with management.



**2\. Travel Agent and Partner Acquisition** 



* Identify, approach, and onboard travel agents, tour operators, independent travel consultants, and relevant distribution partners.
* Build relationships with agency owners and key decision\-makers.
* Evaluate prospective partners for market reach, customer profile, business potential, and commercial suitability.
* Coordinate partner documentation, agreements, and onboarding with the relevant internal teams.
* Maintain a qualified pipeline of prospective partners and ensure timely follow\-up.



**3\. Partner Activation and Relationship Management** 



* Convert newly onboarded partners into active booking partners through structured engagement.
* Conduct regular partner meetings, product presentations, and business reviews.
* Communicate package updates, group departure schedules, availability, and promotional offers.
* Identify reasons for partner inactivity and execute reactivation plans.
* Strengthen retention through responsive service, transparent communication, and reliable booking support.



**4\. Channel Revenue and Commercial Management** 



* Own sales targets and gross margins generated through the partner network.
* Coordinate approved partner pricing, commissions, incentives, and commercial terms.
* Maintain discount discipline and ensure special commitments receive appropriate approval.
* Monitor partner payment schedules and coordinate outstanding collections with Finance.
* Ensure credit arrangements remain within approved terms and limits.
* Track booking cancellations and commercial disputes, coordinating timely resolution.



**5\. Product Promotion and Trade Engagement** 



* Work with Products and Operations to create competitive, saleable travel offerings for the channel.
* Equip partners with accurate itineraries, quotations, sales material, inclusions, exclusions, and booking conditions.
* Organise partner training sessions, webinars, destination presentations, and sales meetings.
* Represent the company at relevant travel trade events, exhibitions, and networking forums.
* Share market intelligence on competitor pricing, destination trends, and partner requirements.
* Recommend joint promotions based on expected business returns.



**6\. Team Leadership and Sales Discipline** 



* Lead and develop the channel sales and B2B business development team.
* Assign territories, partner portfolios, and individual targets.
* Establish clear expectations for partner visits, acquisition, activation, follow\-ups, and bookings.
* Coach team members on travel trade selling, negotiation, and relationship management.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and address gaps through focused action plans.
* Support recruitment and onboarding of channel sales team members.



**7\. Booking Coordination and Partner Experience** 



* Establish clear ownership for partner enquiries, quotations, booking confirmations, and escalations.
* Work closely with Operations, Ticketing, Visa, CRM, and Finance to support smooth execution.
* Ensure commitments made to partners match confirmed availability and service capabilities.
* Resolve channel conflicts, account ownership issues, and pricing concerns within company guidelines.
* Use partner feedback to improve response times, booking processes, and service quality.



**8\. Reporting and Sales Analytics** 



* Maintain accurate partner records, opportunities, and follow\-ups in the CRM.
* Track partner productivity, repeat bookings, territory performance, and sales pipeline.
* Present sales forecasts, commercial risks, and growth opportunities to management.
* Distinguish between registered partners and active, revenue\-generating partners when reporting network growth.



**Candidate Requirements** 




**Mandatory** 



* Relevant channel sales or B2B sales experience within Travel \& Tourism.
* Proven experience building and managing a productive travel agent or tour operator network.
* Strong understanding of domestic and international holiday packages, customised travel, and group departures.
* Demonstrated achievement of channel revenue and partner development targets.
* Experience managing a sales team and reviewing territory\-wise performance.
* Knowledge of travel trade pricing, commissions, margins, payment terms, and booking processes.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, relationship management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in CRM systems, Excel, and sales reporting.
* Willingness to work from Pune and travel regularly for partner meetings and business development.



**Preferred** 



* Established travel trade relationships in Maharashtra and other relevant Indian markets.
* Experience expanding into new territories and activating underperforming partner networks.
* Experience selling outbound holidays and fixed group departures through agents.
* Graduate qualification; an MBA or qualification in Travel \& Tourism will be an advantage.



**Key Performance Indicators** 



* Channel revenue and gross margin achievement.
* Number of qualified partners onboarded.
* Partner activation rate and time to first booking.
* Number of active, revenue\-generating partners.
* Revenue and booking productivity per active partner.
* Repeat business and partner retention.
* Territory\-wise growth and pipeline conversion.
* Collection performance and overdue outstanding amounts.
* Team target achievement.
* Partner enquiry response and escalation resolution times.



**First 90\-Day Priorities** 



* Review the existing partner network, channel revenue, and territory potential.
* Prepare a territory\-wise acquisition and activation plan.
* Implement partner segmentation, CRM discipline, and regular business reviews.
* Launch focused onboarding, training, and reactivation initiatives.
* Build a qualified sales pipeline and deliver against agreed initial targets.



**How to Apply** 




 Share your updated CV with:
 


* Total and relevant Travel \& Tourism experience.
* Current company and designation.
* Territories and partner networks managed.
* Number of active partners handled.
* Team size managed.
* Recent channel sales targets and achievements.
* Current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period.
* Current location and willingness to work from Pune.



**Only candidates with relevant Travel \& Tourism channel sales experience will be considered.**

description:
**WHAT WE DO** 





 FlytBase is the global category leader in Physical AI for Large sites. FlytBase’s drone autonomy platform powers mission\-critical operations across 300\+ enterprise sites in 40\+ countries. Our customers include Fortune 500 leaders such as Shell, CSX, UK Police, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole, and Statnett.
 




  






 FlytBase has its presence in 70\+ countries with offices in the US and Pune, India. FlytBase is building the nervous system for large industrial sites. We operate at AI speed \- autonomy and intelligence at our core. Our lean team thrives in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI is not a side project; it is the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
 




  





**THE ROLE** 





 Industrial sites are going autonomous. Fortune 2000 operations directors, CTOs, and site managers are making the biggest technology bets of their careers \- and you'll be the person they bet on. FlytBase sells Physical AI: autonomous systems that detect failures in real\-time, inspect critical infrastructure around the clock, and act before problems cascade.
 




  






 Your buyers are energy companies, mining firms, and infrastructure operators making their first investment in autonomous site intelligence. As FlytBase's senior commercial leader in your region, you own the full revenue picture: direct enterprise deals, the channel partner ecosystem, and the team around you.
 




  






 This isn't account management. This is building a market. You don't inherit pipeline \- you build the commercial systems that create it. Within 24 hours of engagement, you have a custom proposal ready to present. AI handles the first draft; you own the strategy and conviction.
 




  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 



* Full revenue accountability for your region \- direct enterprise and partner\-sourced deals
* Complex, multi\-stakeholder sales cycles with critical infrastructure operators across energy, mining, and industrial sectors
* Channel partner ecosystem: VARs, drone service providers, and system integrators who sell FlytBase independently
* Team leadership: coaching AEs and BDRs, running deal reviews, setting commercial execution standards
* Market intelligence that directly shapes product roadmap, marketing campaigns, and company strategy
* Customer and partner travel to refineries, pipelines, solar farms, mining operations, and industry events globally
* Territory planning, account strategies, and forecasting discipline \- the systems that compound quarter over quarter
* Solution design and commercial positioning for Physical AI deployments at Fortune 500 industrial sites



  





**BEST SUITED FOR** 



* 3–7 years of experience closing complex B2B enterprise software deals with consistent quota overachievement
* Proven track record of selling into large enterprises across industries such as Oil \& Gas, Mining, Utilities, Ports, Public Safety, Government, or Critical Infrastructure
* Demonstrated experience managing long, multi\-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles involving operations, IT, procurement, security, and executive leadership
* Experience selling software solutions globally from India, working across North America, Europe, APAC, Middle East, and multiple time zones
* Strong consultative selling approach with the ability to translate complex technical platforms into measurable business outcomes for enterprise buyers
* AI\-native approach to enterprise selling: using AI for account research, proposal development, opportunity strategy, and sales workflow automation
* Technical product selling experience with enterprise SaaS, robotics, drones, IoT, industrial software, or adjacent technologies
* Builder mentality: comfortable creating opportunities, developing strategic accounts, and expanding enterprise relationships in emerging markets
* Experience with drones, robotics, AI, industrial automation, or IoT is a strong advantage, but not required



  





**WHAT MAKES YOU A FLYTER** 



* **Full ownership without handholding:** 

 You don't wait for warm leads or defined playbooks \- you build the commercial systems that create pipeline
* **Builder over inheritor:** 

 You've created something from scratch and can articulate exactly how you built it
* **AI acceleration mindset:** 

 You don't just use AI for emails \- you reshape how enterprise selling works with agentic workflows
* **Technical depth without complexity:** 

 You can explain why autonomous inspection changes ROI for a $2B energy company in terms they actually care about
* **International stamina:** 

 You sell across six time zones and travel to industrial sites worldwide without missing a beat



  





**WHAT WE DON'T WANT** 



* Pipeline padders who celebrate activity over impact \- meetings scheduled, emails sent, calls logged
* Relationship managers who avoid technical depth and can't explain how Physical AI actually works
* Reps who wait for the 'right' playbook, warm leads, or support teams to carry their deals
* Anyone who says 'that's not my job' when market intelligence, partner enablement, or team coaching comes up
* Order takers who need defined processes before they can move \- this role is about building the processes



  





**WHY FLYTBASE?** 



* **H3 Philosophy:** 

 We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing \- not as a balance, as a harmony. We move fast without burning out.
* **Radical Ownership:** 

 You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution.
* **Mazaa Aayega:** 

 Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun.
* **Systems That Scale:** 

 We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage.
* **In\-Person Energy:** 

 We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything \- ideas, feedback, trust, and impact \- but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.



  





**THE PERKS** 



* High agency team and deep sense of purpose
* International travel \- we operate across all 6 continents
* Thought leadership \& public speaking at global events
* No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments
* Latest tech stack \- whatever helps you move faster
* Family Day \- once a year we showcase our work to the people who matter most
* Top\-tier health coverage
* Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out)
* A damn good team to work with great talent density

 in the Application and Interview Process

title: Key Account Service Manager
description:
**Purpose of the Role**
 The Key Account Manager (KAM) will serve as the single dedicated relationship owner for one large strategic account within Epiroc India's Parts \& Service Division. The role drives aftermarket revenue growth, long\-term service contract acquisition, equipment uptime, and customer satisfaction for the assigned account. By embedding deeply within the customer's organisation — across project sites, procurement, and senior leadership — the KAM ensures Epiroc is positioned as the preferred productivity partner for all aftermarket parts, service, and maintenance needs. The incumbent aligns account\-level commercial activities with PSD India's national strategy, working in close coordination with the National Sales Manager, National Operations Manager, and Technical Services Manager.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Safety, Compliance \& Governance**
* Our aim is to achieve ZERO INJURY.
* Drive a strong culture of safety, health, and environmental responsibility across all Epiroc activities conducted at the assigned customer's sites.
* Ensure all Epiroc personnel visiting customer sites comply with both Epiroc's and the customer's HSE requirements at all times.
* Ensure adherence to Epiroc's values, ethical standards, commercial governance, and approval authorities in all account dealings.
* Maintain accurate and complete records of all account activity, contracts, pricing, and stakeholder interactions in accordance with Epiroc's data and compliance policies.


**Account Ownership \& Strategic Relationship Management**
* Serve as the single point of contact (SPOC) for the assigned strategic account across all Epiroc PSD touchpoints — parts, service, contracts, technical support, and commercial escalations.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive Account Plan, reviewed and updated quarterly, covering installed base status, contract coverage, revenue forecast, stakeholder map, competitive landscape, and 12\-month growth initiatives.
* Build and sustain multi\-level relationships within the customer organisation — from site and maintenance engineers through procurement and project directors to CFO and MD level for major contract decisions.
* Conduct formal Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with the customer's senior leadership, presenting equipment uptime performance, parts consumption trends, service value delivered, and forward fleet plans.
* Own all customer escalations within Epiroc — coordinate National Operations Manager, Technical Services Manager, and supply chain to resolve within committed SLAs; communicate proactively and transparently to the customer throughout.
* Monitor competitor activity at the account — pricing, service offerings, and fleet penetration — and report intelligence to the National Sales Manager.


**Revenue Growth \& Contract Acquisition**
* Develop and execute the account\-level aftermarket revenue plan, covering spare parts, consumables, service labour, AMC/MARC contracts, and value\-added services, in alignment with PSD India's annual targets.
* Identify and convert all uncontracted Epiroc equipment within the account's fleet into active Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) or Maintenance and Repair Contracts (MARC), working with the Contract Acquisition Manager.
* Drive upselling and cross\-selling across the customer's project sites — equipment overhauls and rebuilds, predictive maintenance packages, digital fleet management solutions (Certiq), and consumable optimisation programmes.
* Lead commercial negotiations on contract renewals, pricing, and scope expansions; seek NSM approval for non\-standard commercial terms.
* Protect and grow genuine parts revenue by positioning OEM parts quality, availability, and total cost of ownership advantages against non\-OEM alternatives; track and improve share\-of\-wallet at the account.
* Prepare accurate monthly revenue forecasts and pipeline reports for the NSM; maintain forecast accuracy within ±5%.


**Contract Delivery \& Operational Oversight (with National Operations Manager)**
* Monitor contract performance on a weekly basis — equipment availability, SLA compliance, response time, and First\-Time Fix Rate — and proactively alert the National Operations Manager to risks before SLA breach occurs.
* Conduct minimum monthly site visits to physically assess Epiroc equipment performance, engage ground\-level maintenance teams, and identify emerging fleet health issues.
* Coordinate with the Contract Management Manager to ensure invoicing, SLA reports, and contractual documentation are delivered to the customer accurately and on schedule.
* Track penalty and liquidated damage (LD) exposure; alert the National Operations Manager when contractual obligations are at risk; own all customer\-facing communications in such situations.
* Support the National Operations Manager in mobilising additional technical resources — field engineers, parts, or specialist support — at the customer's sites during planned shutdowns, peak production phases, or emergency breakdowns.


**Technical Coordination (with Technical Services Manager)**
* Route technical escalations to the Technical Services Manager's Product Specialists promptly when field engineers are unable to resolve equipment failures within the contracted MTTR.
* Provide the Technical Services Manager with detailed customer fleet failure data, site operating conditions, and application context to enable accurate root cause analysis (RCA) and faster resolution.
* Facilitate TSM\-led technical workshops, failure analysis reviews, and product knowledge sessions with the customer's engineering and maintenance teams.
* Coordinate rollout of new equipment models, service bulletins, technical upgrades, and digital tools (Certiq telematics, productivity dashboards, predictive maintenance alerts) at the customer's sites.
* Champion customer adoption of Epiroc's digital fleet management platform and ensure the customer's key operations personnel are trained and actively using available tools.


**Market Intelligence \& Cross\-functional Collaboration**
* Maintain a thorough understanding of the customer's upcoming project pipeline, tender plans, fleet expansion decisions, and capital expenditure cycles; share intelligence with the NSM and Equipment sales team.
* Report customer feedback, unmet needs, and service gaps to the NSM and TSM, driving internal corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with the NSM's Marketing Managers to support account\-specific campaigns, executive events, and value demonstration initiatives.
* Prepare monthly account performance reports, variance analysis, and insights for NSM and senior PSD leadership.


**Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical / Civil / Electrical Engineering or equivalent; MBA is advantageous.
* 8–12 years of experience in aftermarket sales, key account management, or service business development within mining, construction equipment, infrastructure, or heavy industry sectors.
* Demonstrated track record of managing large EPC or mining contractor accounts with a multi\-crore annual revenue portfolio.
* Proven experience in selling and managing long\-term service contracts — AMC, MARC, or Operations \& Maintenance contracts — with a clear understanding of contract P\&L and SLA management.
* Familiarity with Epiroc or competitor mining and infrastructure equipment (drill rigs, surface and underground equipment, hydraulic breakers, and associated consumables) is highly desirable.
* Prior experience working with large Indian infrastructure contractors or mining companies (L\&T, Megha Engineering, Afcons, HCC, NCC, Max Infrastructure, Coal India entities, NMDC, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.
* Experience with ERP/CRM systems, service performance dashboards, and digital fleet management tools.


**Required Skills And Competencies**
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to build investment\-grade business cases, negotiate multi\-crore service contracts, and protect margin while delivering customer value.
* Strategic account planning — proficient in stakeholder mapping, whitespace analysis, and developing 12–24 month account growth strategies.
* Excellent analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills; comfortable interpreting equipment performance data, fleet health dashboards, and service KPI reports.
* Exceptional interpersonal and influencing skills — able to build trust and credibility equally with site\-level maintenance teams and C\-suite decision makers.
* Strong presentation and facilitation skills for executive QBRs, technical review meetings, and contract negotiation sessions.
* Sound understanding of equipment maintenance cycles, service contract structures, parts supply chains, and uptime/availability benchmarks.
* Proficiency in CRM platforms (Salesforce / SAP), MS Office, and Epiroc digital tools; willingness to champion digital adoption with customers.
* Fluency in English; Hindi and regional languages (Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Odia) are advantageous given the diversity of account geographies across India.
* Willingness to travel extensively — 60–70% of working time at customer project sites, mine sites, and regional offices across India, including remote locations.


**Location:** 
 India, Bhubhaneshwar
   

  

**Why Should You Apply for This Position?**
* Opportunity to serve as the senior Epiroc representative for one of India's most significant infrastructure or mining accounts — a high\-visibility, high\-impact role.
* Work within a company that is actively expanding its India footprint — new manufacturing facilities in Nashik and Hyderabad, an innovation and technology centre in Bengaluru, and a growing national PSD organisation.
* Professional development, structured key account management training, global exposure across PSD APAC, and clear long\-term career pathways into National Sales Manager or regional general management roles.
* Collaborative and innovative culture with the freedom to bring ideas to life.
* Commitment to diversity, inclusion, safety, and sustainability.
* Dynamic and challenging environment with direct impact on customer productivity and Epiroc's growth in India.


*Epiroc is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and encourage applications from all qualified candidates.*
**It all starts with people.** 
 The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.
   

  

 All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future.  Learn more at www.epiroc.com

 Because this isn’t a role where everything has already been mapped out for you.
